a: Bavua levavua devavua, nidda deate leveteh. velav milleta hi, dilma chalsha dateh, umittera mazzaleh.
Amar abbaye: hasheta deamrat simana milleta hi, yehe regil inish lemechal resh shatta kara verubbeya, karate, silka vetamre.

Amar lehu rav mesharsheya livneh: ki baetu lemezel lemigmar kamme rabbechon, gerusu meikkara matnitin vahadar ulu kamme rabbechon, vechi yatvitu kamme rabbechon, chazo lefummeh derabbechon, shenneemar: "vehayu enecha root et morecha", vechi garsitu shemata, gerusu al mayya, dechi hechi demashchi mayya timshoch shematechon.
Akkilke demata machseya, vela appadne defumebdita. tav gildana sarya lemechal mikkuttacha derame kefe.

"Vattitpallel channa vattomar alatz libbi baAdonai rama karni", "rama karni" velo "rama pakki" – david ushelomo shennimshechu bekeren – nimshecha malchutam, shaul veyehu shennimshechu min happach – lo nimshecha malchutam.
Hamefattem et hakketoret. tanu rabbanan: hamefattem et hakketoret lelammed bah o lemosrah latztzibbur – patur, lehariach bah – chayyayv. vehammeriach bah patur, ella shemmaal.
Umi ikka meila? vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol umare vareach – en bahen mishshum meila!
Reach achar shettaale timrato en bo mishshum meila, en lecha davar acher shennaasa mitzvato umoalin bo.
Allema la? vahare terumat haddeshen, denaaset mitzvatah umoalin bah!
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedim.
Hanicha lerabbanan, ella lerabbi dosa may ikka lememar? detanya: "vehinnicham sham", melammed shetteunin geniza.
Rabbi dosa omer: kesherin hen lechohen hedyot, uma talmud lomar "vehinnicham sham"? shello yishtammesh bahen beyom hakkippurim acher.

Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin. terumat haddeshen may hi? detanya: "vesamo etzel hammizbeach", melammed shetteunin geniza. egla arufa may hi? detanya: "vearfu sham et haegla bannachal", melammed shetteunin geniza.

Uleman deamar: shene chetuvin habbaim keechad melammedin, hacha vadday en melammedin, mishshum dehave tere miute. bitrumat haddeshen ketiv: "vesamo" – haden in, midde acharina la, gabbe egla arufa ketiv: "haarufa" – arufa in, midde acharina la.

Tanu rabbanan: pittum hakketoret: hatztzori, vehatztzipporen, vehachelbena, vehallevona – mishkal shivim shel shivim mana. mor, uketzia, shibbolet nerd, vecharkom – mishkal shishsha asar shel shishsha asar mane. hakkosht – shenem asar, killufa – shelosha, vekinnamon – tisha. borit karshina – tisha kabbin, yen kafrisin – sein telata kabbin telata. im en lo yen kafrisin mevi chamar chivvaryayn attik. melach sedomit – rova. maale ashan – kol shehu. rabbi natan omer: af kippat hayyarden kol shehu.

Veim natan bah devash – pesalah. chissar achat mikkol sammaneha – chayyayv mita. rabbi shimon omer: hatztzori eno ella seraf meatze hakketaf. borit karshina, sheshshafin bah et hatztzipporen kede shettehe naa. yen kafrisin, sheshshorin bo et hatztzipporen kede shettehe azza. vahalo me raglayim yafin lah, ella sheen machnisin me raglayim lammikdash.
Mesayyay leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina: deamar "kodesh hi kodesh tihye lachem" – kol maaseha lo yehu ella bakkodesh.
Metivi: hammakdish nechasav vehayu bah devarim haruyin lekorbenot hatztzibbur – yinnatnu laummanin bischaran.
Hane devarim haruyin, may ninhu? i behema vechayya – tena leh! i yenot shemanim uselatot – tena leh! ella lav ketoret?

Amar rabbi oshaya: beotah hannittenet leummanim bischaran. detanya: motar hakketoret, ma hayu osin bah? hayu mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin, umechallelin otah al meot haummanin venotnin otan laummanin bischaran, vechozrim velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha.
Matkef la rav yosef: ha bechullehu motarot tane chozrin velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha, vehacha la tane!
Ella amar rav yosef: beechad missammane hakketoret.

Tanu rabbanan: ketoret hayta naaset shelosh meot shishshim ushemona mane, shelosh meot shishshim vachamishsha keneged yemot hachamma, shelosha manin yeterin, shemmehen machnis kohen gadol melo chofnav beyom hakkippurim, vehashshear nittenet laummanin bischaran.
Kidtanya: motar hakketoret ma hayu osin bah? mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin, umechallelin otah al meot haummanin venotnin otan laummanin bischaran, vechozrin velokchin otah mitterumat hallishka.
b: Tanu rabbanan: motar hakketoret, achat leshishshim o leshivim shana, hayu mefattemin otah lachatzain. lefichach yachid sheppittem lachatzain – chayyayv, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel, sheamar mishshum hassegan.
Aval shelish urevia lo shamati. vachachamim omrim: bechol yom metakken bematkunetah, vehaya machnis.
Mesayyay leh lerava, deamar rava: shemen hammishcha sheppittemo lachatzain – chayyayv, dichtiv: "vehakketoret asher taase" – kol shettaase, veha efshar deavda peras beshacharit uferas ben haarbayim.

Tanu rabbanan: hayu machazirin otah lemachteshet paamayim beshana, bimot hachamma pezura – shello titappesh, bimot haggeshamim tzevura – kede shello tafug rechah. ucheshehu shochek, omer: hadek hetev, hetev hadek, divre abba yose ben yochanan.

Veshalosh manin yeterin shemmehen kohen gadol machnis melo chofnav beyom hakkippurim, noten otah lemachteshet beerev yom hakkippurim, veshochakan yafe yafe, kede shettehe dakka min haddakka, kidtanya: "dakka", ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar: "veshachakta mimmennu hadek", ma talmud lomar: "dakka"? kede shettehe dakka min haddakka.
Amar mar: keshehu shochek, omer "hetev hadek, hadek hetev": mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: keshem shehaddibbur ra layyayin – ken haddibbur yafe labbesamim.

Amar rabbi yochanan: achad asar sammanin neemru lo lemoshe besinay. amar rav huna: may keraa? "kach lecha sammim" – tere, "nataf ushechelet vechelbena" – ha chamsha, vesammim" acharine – chamsha, ha asra, "ulevona zakka" – chad, ha chad sere.

Veema "sammim" – kalal, "nataf ushechelet vechelbena" – parat, "sammim" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash – davar shekkitter veole verecho nodef, af kol davar shekkitter veole verecho nodef.

Vechi tema, im ken, lichtov kera chad perata! laye, mitzrach tzerichi, dei ketav "nataf" hava amena: min ilan – in, aval giddule karka – la, mishshum hachi ketav: "ushechelet". vei ketav "ushechelet", hava amena: giddule karka – in, aval min ilan – ema la, mishshum hachi ketav: "nataf".
Vechelbena legufeh ata, mippene sherechah ra! im ken, mikkach lecha" nafka leh.
Veema: "sammim" batrae teren ninhu, kesammim" kadmae! im ken, nichtov "sammim" "sammim" bahade hadade, vesof nichtov "nataf ushechelet vechelbena".

Deve rabbi yishmael tane: "sammim" – kalal, "nataf shechelet vechelbena" – parat, "sammim" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash – davar shekkitter veole verecho nodef, af kol davar shekkitter veole verecho nodef.
O eno ella kelal bichlal rishon, uferat bifrat rishon? amrat lav. ha en lecha alecha ladun belashon acharon, ella belashon rishon.

Amar mar: o eno ella kelal bichlal rishon, uferat bifrat rishon? amrat lav, ha en alecha ladun. may kusheya? hachi ka kashya leh: "sammim" batrae tere, ki sammim kadmae teren! hadar veshanni kidshannin, deim ken nichtov kera: "sammim sammim nataf ushechelet vechelbena".

Umay. "perat bifrat rishon"? hachi ka kashya leh: mine ilanot yalfi min nataf, vegiddule karka yalfi mishshechelet, velelfi name millevona zakka, deayyte bechad tzad, denete davar sherecho nodef veaf al pi sheen koter veole!
Hadar amar: im ken, nichtov kera lilvona zakka bemitze, vetelaf minna.
I katvay levona zakka bemitze, havayin tere asar! im ken, nichtov kera levona zakka bemitze, vechelbena levassof. resh lakish amar: miggufa, ma leshon "ketoret"? davar shekkoter veole.

Amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: kol taanit sheen bah mipposhe yisrael enah taanit, shehare chelbena rechah ra umenaah hakkatuv im sammane ketoret. abbaye amar: mehacha: "vaaguddato al eretz yesadah"

Vehassach beshemen hammishcha. tanu rabbanan: hassach beshemen hammishcha livhema vechelim – patur, legoyim ulemetim – patur. bishlama behema vechelim, dichtiv: "al besar adam lo yisach", uvehema vechelim lav adam hu. metim name patur, dechevan demit leh – met mikkere, velav adam. ella goyim, ammay patur? ha adam ninhu!
Laye, dichtiv: "veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem" – attem keruyin "adam" veen haggoyim keruyin "adam".
Vehachtiv: "venefesh adam shishsha asar alef"! amar leh: hahu leappoke behema.
Vehachtiv: "vaani lo achus al ninve vegomer"! hahu leappoke behema.
Veibbaet ema – kidkatane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar: kol sheyyeshno besach – yeshno beval yisach, vechol sheeno besach – eno beval yisach.

Tanya iddach: hassach beshemen hammishcha livhema vechelim, legoyim umetim – patur, limlachim ulechohanim – rabbi meir mechayyev, verabbi yehuda poter. vechamma yasuch vihe chayyayv? rabbi meir omer: kol shehu, rabbi yehuda omer: kezayit. vehaamar rabbi yehuda: patur! ki patar rabbi yehuda – gabbe melachim vechohanim, gabbe hedyot mechayyev.

Rabbi meir verabbi yehuda bemay peligi amar rav yosef: beha peligi – rabbi meir savar: "al besar adam lo yisach" ketiv, uchetiv: "vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar", ma sicha kol shehu – af netina kol shehu.
Verabbi yehuda savar: yalfinan netina deal zar minnetina dealma, ma netina dealma kezayit, af netina deal zar – kezayit. aval sicha lemimshach melachim vechohanim – divre hakkol kol shehu.

Veamar rav yosef: bemay peligi rabbi meir verabbi yehuda gabbe melachim vechohanim? rabbi meir savar: "vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar" ketiv, umelech vechohen hasheta zarim ninhu. verabbi yehuda savar: baenan ad deikka zar mittechillato vead sofo, umelech vechohen meikkara lav zarim havu.
Amar rav ika bereh derav amme: veazdu letamayyhu, detanya:

a: Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael, veachla bitruma – meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh, umitatah bisrefa.
Nisset leechad min happesulin – meshallemet keren vachomesh, umitatah bechenek, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: achat zo veachat zo meshallemet [et] hakkeren veenah meshallemet [et] hachomesh, umitatah bisrefa.
Amar rav yosef: machloket bintinat shemen hammishcha uveshinnuye deshanninan, aval netina dealma – divre hakkol kezayit.
Gufa. tane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar: kol sheyyeshno besach – yeshno beval yisach, vechol sheeno besach – eno beval yisach. amar leh: shappir kaamrat, "lo yisach" ketiv, ukeri beh "lo yassich".

Tane rav chananya kammeh derava: minnayin lechohen gadol shennatal mishshemen hammishcha sheal rosho venatan al bene meav, minnayin shehu chayyayv? shenneemar: "al besar adam lo yisach". amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: may shena meha detanya: kohen shessach beshemen shel teruma, ben bitto yisrael mitaggel bo veeno choshesh?

Amar leh: hatam, "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu" ketiv – kevan dechalleleh ha ittachayl, aval gabbe shemen hammishcha ketiv: "ki nezer [shemen mishchat] elohav alav" – "shemen mishcha" karyeh rachamana, deaf al gav deiteh alav la ittachayl.
Al ellu chayyayvin al zedono kulei. katane: chutz mimmetamme mikdash vekadashav. mimmay mappek leh? hachi katane: chutz mimmittamme mikdash vekadashav, sheen mevi asham taluy.

Venitne name: chutz mimmi sheavar alav yom hakkippurim, sheen mevi asham taluy! amar resh lakish: ki katane, hecha deiteh lachatae verachamana patreh. avar alav yom hakkippurim leteh lachatae, deka chappar leh.
Rabbi yochanan amar: bimvaet, dekaamar: en yom hakkippurim mechapper, dei hadar beh batar yom hakkippurim, bae leetoye asham taluy. veresh lakish savar: mevaet name mechappar aleh yom hakkippurim.

Uviflugeta: haomer: "lo yitkapper li chattati", abbaye amar: enah mechapperet, rava amar: mechapperet. hecha deamar: "lo tikrav" – dechulle alma la peligi dela mechappera, dichtiv: "yakriv oto" – lirtzono. ki peligi, deamar: "tikrav velo techapper", abbaye amar: en mechapperet, deha amar lo techapper. rava amar: mechapperet, kevan deamar tikrav – kappara mimmela (ate).

Vahadar beh rava, kidtanya: yachol yehe yom hakkippurim mechapper al shavin veal sheen shavin? vedin hu, uma chattat veasham mechapperin veyom hakkippurim mechapper, ma chattat veasham en mechapperin ella al hashshavin af yom hakkippurim en mechapper ella al hashshavin!

Lo, im amarta bechattat veasham, sheen mechapperin al hammezid kashshogeg, tomar beyom hakkippurim, shemmechapper al hammezid kashshogeg. vehoil umechapper al hammezid kashshogeg, mechapper al shavin veal sheen shavin! talmud lomar: "ach", chalak.
May "shavin" vesheen shavin"? illema "shavin" – shogeg, "lo shavin" – mezid, ha katane: lo im amarta bechattat veasham kulei!
Ella, ki ha deulla amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev vehifrish korban, venishtammed vechazar bo, hoil venidcha – yiddache.
Nehi deiddechi korban, gavra bar kappara hu! ella "shavin" – deamar: "yechapper alay chattati", "sheen shavin" – deamar: "lo techapper alay chattati", shema minna:

Ureminhi: yachol lo yehe yom hakkippurim mechapper ella al shennitanna bo velo asa bo melacha ukerao mikra kodesh, lo nitanna bo veasa bo melacha velo kerao mikra kodesh yachol lo yehe yom kippurim mechapper? talmud lomar: "yom hakkippurim hu", mikkol makom. vetarvayyhu setam sifra hu, kashyayn ahadade!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: ha – rabbi allibba derabbi yehuda, ha – rabbi allibba dideh, detanya: rabbi omer: kol averot shebbattora, ben asa teshuva uven lo asa teshuva – yom hakkippurim mechapper,
Chutz mipporek ol, umegalle panim battora, umefer berit basar, sheim asa teshuva – yom hakkippurim mechapper, veim lav – en yom hakkippurim mechapper.

Rava amar: ha veha rabbi allibba denafsheh, umode rabbi baaverot deyom hakkippurim gufeh – dela mechappar. dei la tema hachi, karet deyom hakkippurim lerabbi, kevan divchol shata veshata mechappar, hechi mashkachat la?
Umay kusheya? dilma daavad avidta kulle lelya uvahade ammud hashshachar mit, dela hava yemama dilchappar leh! tinach karet delelya, karet dimama hechi mashkachat la?

Umay kusheya? dilma bahade dekaachal nahama chanakteh umetza, dela hava leh shehut bimama dilchappar leh. i name, daavad avidteh samuch lishkiat hachamma. i name, bahade deaved avidteh paskeh mara leshakeh umit, dela hava leh shehut bimama dilchappar leh.
Vachachamim omrim af hamegaddef kulei. may af hamegaddef sheen bo maase?
Rabbanan shemau lerabbi akiva detane baal ov vela tane yiddeoni, amaru leh: may shena dela mayyte korban, mishshum delet beh maase? megaddef name let beh maase!

Tanu rabbanan: megaddef mevi korban, hoil veneemar bo karet, divre rabbi akiva, veomer: "venasa cheto". uchelala hu, kol hecha dichtiv beh karet mayyte korban? veha pesach umila dichtiv behu karet vela mayyte korban!
b: Hachi kaamar: megaddef mevi korban hoil uva bo karet bimkom korban, divre rabbi akiva. kasavar: miggo devae michtav karet bealma, uchetiv karet bimkom korban, shema minna mayyte korban.
Veomer: "cheto yissa". ata[50] lerabbanan, vehachi kaamar rabbi akiva lerabbanan: amritu megaddef let beh maase, mahu megaddef – mevarech et hashshem. ella karet dichtiv, lemay ata?
Amri leh: litten karet limkallel, dichtiv bimkallel: ("cheto yissa haish hahu") ["venasa cheto"], uchetiv befesach sheni: "cheto yissa", ma lehallan – karet, af kan – karet.
Tanu rabbanan: "et Adonai [hu] megaddef", isi ben yehuda omer: keadam haomer lachavero "gerafta hakkeara vechissartah". kasavar: megaddef – mevarech et hashshem hu.
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: keadam haomer lachavero "gerafta hakkeara velo chissartah". kasavar: megaddef – hayeynu oved avoda zara.
Tanya iddach: "et Adonai", rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: beoved avoda zara hakkatuv medabber, vachachamim omrim: lo ba hakkatuv ella litten karet limvarech hashshem.
Mishna yesh meviot korban veneechol, veyesh meviot korban veeno neechol, veyesh sheenam meviot.
Meviot korban veneechol: hammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyehe bo mitztzurat adam.
Hammappelet sandal o shilya o shappir merukkam, vehayyotze mechuttach, vechen shifcha shehippila, mevia korban veneechol.

Veellu meviot veenan neechalot: hammappelet veen yodea ma hippila, ushete nashim shehippilu, achat mimmin petur veachat mimmin chova. amar rabbi yose: ematay? bizman shehalchu ze lammizrach veze lammaarav. aval im hayu shetehen omdot – shetehen meviot korban, veneechol.

Ellu sheen meviot: hammappelet shappir male mayim, male dam, male geninim, hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim ushekatzim uremasim, hammappelet yom arbaim, veyotze dofen. rabbi shimon mechayyev beyotze dofen.
Gemara shifcha menalan? detanu rabbanan: "bene yisrael", en li ella bene yisrael, giyyoret veshifcha minnayin? talmud lomar: "ishsha".

May "vechen shifcha"? salka datach amena: ki amrinan kol mitzva shehaishsha chayyevet bah – eved chayyayv bah, hane mille bedavar sheshshave ben ish uven ishsha. aval yoledet, divnashim ita, baanashim leta, ema la tichayyayv shifcha, ahachi tena: shifcha.
Ellu meviin korban kulei. may avdin? mayytyan tarvayyhu chad korban vadday, vechattat of safek, umatne.
Umi it leh lerabbi yose tenaa? vehatnan: rabbi shimon omer: meviot shenehen chattat achat. rabbi yose omer en shenehen meviot chattat achat. alma lerabbi yose let leh tenaa!
Amar rava: mode rabbi yose bimchussar kappara. vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: mode rabbi yose bimchussar kappara.
May tama? hatam bae gavra yedia, dichtiv: "o hoda elav chattato" hilkach, la matyayn umatneya[yn]. aval hacha, ki matyayn nashim korban – leishteroye baachilat kadashim.
Kidtane sefa dehahi: rabbi yose omer: kol chattat shehi baa al chet – en shetayim meviot otah.
Ellu sheen meviot kulei rabbi shimon mechayyev beyotze dofen. may tama derabbi shimon? amar resh lakish: amar kera: "veim nekeva teled", lerabbot leda acheret, may hi – yotze dofen.
Verabbanan may tama? amar rabbi manni bar pattish: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda" – ad shetteled mimmakom shemmazraat.
Mishna hammappelet leor shemonim veechad, bet shammay potrin min hakkorban, uvet hillel mechayyeyvin.
Amru bet hillel levet shammay: may shena or shemonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad? im shayva lo letumea, lo yishve lo lekorban?

Amru lahem bet shammay: lo, im amartem bemappelet yom shemonim veechad, shekken yatza leshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban, tomar bemappelet leor shemonim veechad, shello yatza leshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban.
Amru lahen bet hillel: vahalo hammappelet yom shemonim veechad shechal lihyot beshabbat tochiach, shello yatza leshaa shehi reuya lehavi bah korban, vechayyevet korban!

Amru lahen bet shammay: lo, im amartem yom shemonim veechad shechal lihyot bashshabbat, sheaf al pi sheeno rauy lekorban yachid, rauy lekorban tzibbur, tomar bemappelet leor shemonim yom veechad, sheen hallayla rauy lo lekorban yachid velo lekorban tzibbur?
Vehaddamim enan mochichim, shehammappelet betoch melot – dameha temeim, ufetura min hakkorban.

a: Gemara tanya: amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay: hare hu omer: "levat" lerabbot or shemonim veechad.
Rabbi hoshaya hava shechiach kammeh devar kappara, shavkeh vaata kammeh derabbi chiyyay. yoma chad pega beh, bea minneh: zav sheraa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini, ma bet hillel omrim bedavar ze?
Tamayyhu devet hillel bemappelet ballayla mishshum dichtiv: "levat", aval zav sheraa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini – patri, dela meyaytri kerae, o dilma la shena?

Amar leh bar kappara: ma bavli omer bedavar ze? ishtik rabbi hoshaya, la amar kelum. amar leh bar kappara: tzerichin ledivre iyyay? nachzor al harishonot: hare hu omer: "levat" – lerabbot or shemonim veechad.

Nema ketannae: zav sheraa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini, tane chada: mevi, vetanya iddach: eno mevi. may lav tannae hi, deha detanya mevi, kasavar: layla en mechussar zeman, vehadtane en mevi, kasavar: layla mechussar zeman?
Amar rav huna bar acha amar rabbi elazar: hane tannae savri layla mechussar zeman. veha detanya mevi – bezav baal shete reiyyot, vehadtanya en mevi – bezav baal shalosh reiyyot.
Zav baal shete reiyyot, may lememra? ha ka mashma lan: davka raa belel shemini, aval bimama dishvii, la. kasavar: kol reiyyay shessoteret – en mevia lide korban.

Amar rava: ammay okemta leha detanya en mevi – bezav baal shalosh reiyyot, litneyay gabbe, chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harebe! – la pesika, deamar rabbi yochanan: raa achat ballayla ushetayim bayyom – mevi, shetayim ballayla veachat bayyom – en mevi.
Amar rav yosef: teda deachat ballayla ushetayim bayyom mevi, deha reiyyay rishona shichvat zera bealma, veillu chaze tarten achranyayta mitztarfi lehu.

Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: midde irya? reiyyay rishona shel zav – chazyay bizman chiyyuva. achat ballayla, kevan delav bizman chiyyuva chazyay, i lav deashmeinan rabbi yochanan demitztarfa, hava amena la titzteref.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan: layla mechussar zeman?
Vehaamar chizkiyya: nitma bayyom – mevi, ballayla – en mevi. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu ballayla – mevi!
Ki kaamar rabbi yochanan: "shetayim ballayla veachat bayyom – en mevi", ledivre haomer mechussar zeman.
Ledivre haomer? peshita! raa achat ballayla ushetayim bayyom itztericha leh. mahu detema: kevan delav bizman chiyyuva kachaze leh – la titzteref, ka mashma lan.

Mishna haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh ledot usefek chamesh zivot – mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova. chamesh zivot vaddaot vechamesh ledot vaddaot – mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim vehashshear aleha chova.

Maase sheamdu kinnin birushalayim bedinar zahav, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hammaon hazze, lo alin hallayla ad sheyyihye bedinarin (bassof) [kesef!] nichnas levet din velimmed: "haishsha sheyyesh aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot chamesh zivot vaddaot – mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova" veamdu kinnin bayyom hahu berivatayim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: chamesh ledot vadday chamesh zivot safek o chamesh ledot vadday vechamesh ledot safek – mevia shete kinnin, achat al havvadday veachat al hassafek, shel vadday neechelet vehashshear aleha chova, shel safek en neechelet veen hashshear aleha chova.

Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: al vadday tomar: "al haacharona" vetippater. shel safek, im yesh vadday benehen, tomar: "al havvadday" vetippater, veim lav, tomar: "al echad mehen" vetippater. rabbi akiva omer: ben al havvadday ben al hassafek, tomar: "al achat mehen" vetippater.

Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav pappa, ema lach mishshemeh derava: hane tannae bemay peligi, derabbi yochanan ben nuri medamme lehon lechattat, deman dechayyayv chamesh chattaot ad demayyte kullehon vesof mikkappar leh, hacha name la shena.
Verabbi akiva medamme lehon litvilot, deman dimchayyayv chamesh tevilot, kevan detavel chada zimna ittehar, hacha name la shena.
Amar leh rav pappa: i salka datach rabbi yochanan ben nuri lechattat medamme lehon, ammay shel safek tomar: "al achat mehen", vetippater? illu man dimchayyayv
b: Chamesh ashamot teluyin, ki mayyte chad mi mippetar? vehatanya, ze hakkelal: kol shechalukin bechattaot – chalukin baashamot!
Ella, dechulle alma litvilot medamme lehon, uvechoshshin lifshia kamippalgi, rabbi yochanan ben nuri savar: chayyshinan lifshia, verabbi akiva savar: la chayyshinan lifshia.
Hadaran alach sheloshim vashesh
Mishna arbaa mechussere kappara, vearbaa meviin al hazzadon kashshogeg.
Veellu hen mechussere kappara: hazzav, vehazzava, vehayyoledet, vehametzora.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ger mechussar kappara ad sheyyizzarek alav haddam. nazir – leyeno vetiglachto vetumeato.
Gemara may shena zav vezava demane lehon bitren – mishshum dachalukah tumeato, dezav la metamme beones vezava la metammea biriyyot veyamim,

Detanya: "mibbesaro" – velo mechamat onso. (umi tame) [umittamme] biriyyot kivyamim, detanya: tala hakkatuv et hazzachar biriyyot veet hannekeva beyamim. vezava mittammea beones, velo mittammea biriyyot kivyamim.
Metzora umetzoraat name chaluka tumeatan, dimtzora taun peria uferima, dichtiv: "begadav yihyu ferumim verosho yihye farua". veasur betashmish hammitta.
Umetzoraat enah teuna peria uferima, detanya: en li ella ish, ishsha minnayin? keshehu omer: "vehatztzarua" – hare kan shenayim.

Im ken ma talmud lomar: "ish"? nitteko hakkatuv meinyan shel mala leinyan shel matta, lomar: ish porea uforem, veen haishsha poraat uforemet. umutteret betashmish hammitta, shenneemar: "veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim" – velo michutz leoholah.
Hilkach namninhu bitren! zav vezava – ikkar tumeatan chaluka, metzora umetzoraat – en ikkar tumeatan chaluka, hay vehay kigris hu.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ger mechussar kulei. vetanna kamma, may tama la tane ger? ki katane – middaam demish[t]re lemechal bekadashim, ger – ki ka mayyte korban leachshore nafsheh lemeal bekahal.
Venazir may tama la tane? sof sof nazir name ki mayyte korban – leishteroye lemishte yayin dechullin hu.
Verabbi eliezer, dekatane nazir lemishre nafsheh, nitne name nazir tame! ki ka mayyte korban – lemechal aleh nezirut betohora hu.
Tanu rabbanan: ger meukkav leechol bekadashim ad sheyyavi kinno, hevi perida achat shacharit – ochel bekadashim laerev. kol hakkinnin shebbattora – echad chattat veechad ola, kan – shetehen olot.
Hevi chovato min habbehema – yatza, ola ushelamim – yatza, mincha ushelamim – lo yatza. lo amru ken ella lehakel.
May shena mincha ushelamim delo yatza, dichtiv: "kaasher taasu ken yaase", ma attem ola ushelamim – af ger ola ushelamim?
Im ken, chovato achat min habbehema la tisge aleh begavvevy, dehachtiv: "kaasher taasu ken yaase"! amar rav pappa, yesh lomar: leof itrabbi, leolat behema lo kol shekken?
I hachi, afillu mincha name! mayet kera: "ken".

Vaof hecha itrabbi? detanu rabbanan: "kaasher taasu ken yaase" – ma attem ola ushelamim, af hu ola ushelamim, shenneemar: "kachem kagger". minnayin lerabbot et haof? talmud lomar: "ishshe reach nichoach laAdonai" – eze davar shekkullo laAdonai? heve omer [zo] olat haof.

a: Yachol sheani merabbe afillu mincha? talmud lomar: "ken".
Tanya iddach: "veasa ishshe reach nichoach laAdonai", shomea ani kol sheole laishshim, afillu mincha? talmud lomar: "kaasher taasu ken yaase" – ma attem mine damim, af hem mine damim.
I ma attem ola ushelamim, af hem ola ushelamim! talmud lomar: "kachem kagger yihye" – lachem hikkashtiv, velo ledavar acher, lekorbenotechem.
Rabbi omer: "kachem" – kaavotechem, ma avotechem lo nichnesu labberit ella bemila utevila veharetzaat dam – af hem lo yikkansu labberit ella bemila utevila veharetzaat damim.
Lehavi perida achat – i efshar, shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah. lo amru ken ella lehakel alav.

Vela? vehatanya: "vehikrivo", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar betorim: "vehikriv", shomea ani haomer: "hare alay olat haof" lo yifchot mishshene feridin? talmud lomar: "vehikrivo" – afillu perida achat! – chova miha la ashkechan.
Vehaikka yoledet, dematya ben yona o tor lechattat! – mishshum deikka keves bahada.

Amar mar: ma avotechem lo nichnesu labberit ella kulei. bishlama mila, dichtiv: "ki mulim hayu kol haam hayyotzim", i name mehacha: "veeevor alayich vaerech mitboseset bedamayich vaomar lach bedamayich chayi vegomer".
Haretzaat damim, dichtiv: "vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael". ella tevila menalan? dichtiv: "vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam veyizrok al haam" – veen hazzaa belo tevila.
Ella meatta, haiddana delekka korban la nekabbel gerim! amar rav acha bar yaakov: "vechi yagur ittechem ger asher betochchem vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: ger bizman hazze – tzarich sheyyafrish rova lekinno. amar rabbi shimon: kevar nimna (alav) [aleha] rabban yochanan ben zakkay uvittelah, mippene hattakkala. amar rav idi bar gershom amar rav adda bar ahava: halacha kerabbi shimon.
Veikka dematne la al hada, detanu rabbanan: ger toshav muttar laasot melacha beshabbat leatzmo keyisrael bechullo shel moed.

Rabbi akiva omer: keyisrael beyom tov. rabbi yose omer: ger toshav ose bashshabbat leatzmo keyisrael bachol. rabbi shimon omer: echad ger toshav veechad eved veama hattoshavim osin melacha bashshabbat leatzman keyisrael bachol.
Mishna ellu meviin al hazzadon kashshogeg: habba al shifcha, venazir shennitma, ushevuat haedut, ushevuat happikkadon.
Chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harebe, vachamishsha meviin korban ole veyored. ellu meviin korban echad al averot harebe: habba al shifcha biot harebe, venazir shennitma tumeot harebe.
Gemara habba al hashshifcha, menalan?

Detanu rabbanan: "vechipper alav hakkohen beel haasham al chattato asher chata", melammed shemmevi korban echad al averot harebe. "beel haasham... venislach lo mechattato asher chata" – laasot shogeg kemezid.
Nazir shennitma, menalan?
Dichtiv: "vechi yamut met alav befeta pitom", "peta" – ze shogeg, vechen hu omer: "im befeta belo eva hadafo", "pitom" – ze ones, vechen hu omer: "vayyomer Adonai pitom el moshe".
Tanya iddach: "pitom" – ze mezid, vechen hu omer: "arum raa raa venistar ufetaim avru veneenashu".
Nichtov kera "pitom", demashma shogeg, umashma mezid, umashma ones. mezid veones – kedaamaran, umashma name shogeg, dichtiv: "peti yaamin lechol davar", vela nichtov kera "peta"!
I ketav kera "pitom", demashma shogeg umashma mezid umashma ones, hava amena: ki mayyte korban – beshogeg, midde dehave attora kulla, aval ones umezid ema la,
Ketav rachamana "peta", deshogeg hu, legalloye aleh defitom deones umezid hu, daafillu hachi chayyev rachamana.
Shevuat haedut, menalan? detanu rabbanan: bechullan neemar "venelam", kan lo neemar "venelam" – lechayyev al hashshogeg kemezid.
Shevuat happikkadon, menalan? yalef "techta" "techta" mishshevuat haedut.
Chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harebe. katane: habba al hashshifcha biot harebe. menalan?

Detanu rabbanan: "vechipper alav hakkohen beel haasham al chattato asher chata", melammed shemmevi korban echad al averot harebe. "beel haasham venislach lo mechattato asher chata" – laasot mezid keshogeg.
Veha kera, ki ketiv – bemezid ketiv! ella ema: laasot shogeg kemezid.

Bea minneh rabbi chanina tirnaa merabbi yochanan: habba al chamesh shefachot charufot behelem echad, mahu? chayyayv al kol achat veachat, o eno chayyayv ella achat? amar leh: chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
May shena mechamishsha[5] helemot beshifcha achat? amar leh: (en) shifcha achat [en] gufin muchelakin, chamesh shefachot gufin muchelakin.
Umenalan degabbe shifcha gufin muchelakin? amar leh: lav amrat gabbe arayot "veishsha" – lechallek al kol ishsha veishsha? gabbe shifcha name ketiv: "asher yishkav et ishsha shichvat zera
b: Vehi shifcha" – lechallek al kol shifcha veshifcha.
Nazir shennitma tumeot harebe. man tanna?

Amar rav chisda: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, deamar: nezirut detohora mishshevii hu dechayyla aleh. umashkachat la kegon shennitma bashshevii, vechazar venitma bashshevii, vechevan delo yatza shaa haruya lehakeriv bah korban – eno chayyayv ella korban echad.
Dei rabbi, kevan deamar rabbi: nezirut detohora ad shemini la chayyla aleh, i denitma bashshevii vechazar venitma bashshevii – kulla tumea arichta hi,
I denitma bashshemini vechazar venitma bashshemini, kevan deyatzat shaa sheruyay lehakeriv korban – mechayyev al kol achat veachat! ella shema minna rabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Umay derabbi yose berabbi yehuda? detanya: "vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu" – beyom havaat korbenotav, divre rabbi.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: beyom tiglachto.
Mishna hamekanne leishto al yede anashim harebe umetzora shennitnagga negaim harebe,
Hevi tzipporin venitnaggea – lo alu lo ad sheyyavi chattato, rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyavi ashamo.
Gemara menalan? dichtiv: "zot torat hakkenaot" – tora achat lekinnuyin harebe.
Metzora shennitnaggea negaim harebe kulei. menalan? dichtiv: "zot torat hammetzora" – tora achat limtzoraim harebe.
Hevi tzipporin venitnaggea – lo alu lo ad sheyyavi chattato, rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyavi ashamo.

Vehaamrat: en mevi ella korban echad! chassore michassera vehachi katane: hevi tzipporin venitnaggea – en mevi ella korban echad. uleakboe baaniyyut uvaashirut – la mikkeva, ad sheyyavi chattat. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyavi ashamo.

Tenan hatam: metzora shehevi ashamo veheeshir – hakkol holech achar chattat, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: hakkol holech achar asham. tanya rabbi eliezer ben, yaakov omer: hakkol holech achar tzipporin.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: shelashtan mikra echad darshu – "asher lo tassig yado betohorato", rabbi shimon savar: davar hamechappero, rabbi yehuda savar: davar hammachshiro, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: davar haggorem lo tohora, umay ninhu? tzipporin.
Mishna haishsha sheyyalda veladot harebe, vehippila betoch shemonim nekeva, chazra vehippila betoch shemonim nekeva,
Vehammappelet teomim,
Rabbi yehuda omer: mevia al harishon veenah mevia al hashsheni. mevia al hashshelishi veenah mevia al harvii.

Gemara menalan? detane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: "zot torat hayyoledet lazzachar velannekeva" – melammed shemmevia korban echad al veladot harebe. yachol af al halleda veal hazziva? talmud lomar: "zot".
Katane: yachol al halleda veal hazziva enah mevia ella korban echad. ella meatta, achla dam veyalda, hachi name deen mevia ella korban echad?
Ema hachi: yachol al halleda shellifne melot veal halleda shelleachar melot? talmud lomar: "zot".
Hippila betoch shemonim kulei. keshettimmetze lomar ledivre rabbi yehuda – valad rishon gorem umivvalad rishon mona. ledivre chachamim – valad sheni gorem umivvalad sheni mona.
Keshettimtze lomar? peshita, hachi ita! mappelet teomim itzterich leh, salka datach amena bemappelet teomim mode rabbi yehuda lerabbanan, ka mashma lan.
Ibbaya lehu:

a: Betumea ma li amar rabbi yehuda? mi amrinan: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda valad sheni keman deleteh dame ella leinyan korban, kevan delo yatza shaa sheruya lehakeriv bah korban, hoil vechen – valad sheni keman deleteh dame, aval leinyan tumea vetohora, ema sevira leh keman deiteh dame, umafseka tumea desheni, umemalle yome tohora derishon vahadar (mone) [mane leh] yome,
O dilma lerabbi yehuda chumera hu deit leh, aval hacha – kulla hu, vekulla let leh.
Amar rav huna missura, ta shema: yoledet, shochatin vezorkin aleha beyom arbaim lazzachar uveyom shemonim lannekeva.
Ad kan? temea hi! veamar rav chisda: ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: valad sheni keman deleteh dame.

Vei amrat betumea sevira leh lerabbi yehuda valad sheni keman deiteh dame, hechi shachatinan ala beyom arbaim? leureta name la matzya achla! ella lav shema minna: letohora uletumea sevira leh lerabbi yehuda valad sheni keman deleteh dame!
Leolam ema lach: letumea uletohora sevira leh lerabbi yehuda devalad sheni keman deiteh dame, vechi tanya hahi – befesach habba betumea.
Umi achla? vehatnan: pesach habba betumea, lo yochlu mimmennu zavim vezavot, niddot veyoldot!
Hahi, la achlan ki la tevilan. ki tanya hahi deshochatin vezorkin aleha, deha tavla. i hachi, mishshemini dilay hu dechazya!
Mishshemini la chazya, kasavar: tevul yom dezav – kezav dame.
I hachi, beyom arbaim name la chazya! laye, beyom arbaim chazya, kasavar: mechussar kippurim dezav – lav kezav dame.

Ulerava, deamar mechussar kippurim dezav kezav dame, ha matniyta hechi metaretz la? amar rav ashe: rava metaretz la beyom arbaim litzirat zachar uveyom shemonim litzirat nekeva, verabbi yishmael hi, deamar: lezachar arbaim veechad, linkeva shemonim veechad.
Sof sof, tippok li ditmea hi mishshum nidda! – beleda yabbishta. i hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: i efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam, ka mashma lan deefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam.

Amar rabbi shemaya, ta shema: "shishshim", yachol ben retzufin ben mefuzzarin? talmud lomar: "yom", ma yom ratzuf – af shishshim kullan retzufin. manni? illema rabbanan, mi it [lehu] lerabbanan mefuzzarin?
Ella lav rabbi yehuda hi, umiddeka yahev la shishshim retzufim bahade hadade, shema minna chumera it leh, lerabbi yehuda kulla let leh!
La, leolam rabbanan hi. vehacha vemay askinan – leyoledet zachar mittoch shemonim shel nekeva.

Sof sof, shalmin yome dekadmaa, vead kan devatraa la shalmin, deha rabbanan levalad sheni manu! ella mashkachat la lerabbanan – beyoledet teomim, nekeva kadmayyta vezachar batraa, uchegon diledteh lezachar batraa beesrim leyome tohora, devaaya minkat leh shiva yome tumea deleda (teomim nekeva),

Vehachi kaamar: yachol hecha deyalda teomim, nekeva meikkara vezachar levassof, tafsek tumea deleda bemitze, venimne la shishsha veshishshim mefuzzarin? talmud lomar: "yom", ma yom kullo ratzuf – af shishshim kullam retzufin.
Amar abbaye, ta shema: "sheloshim" – yachol ben retzufin ben mefuzzarin? talmud lomar: "yom", ma yom kullo ratzuf – af sheloshim retzufin. manni ha? illema rabbanan, umi it lehu lerabbanan
b: Mefuzzarin? ha amri rabbanan: levalad sheni manya! ella lav rabbi yehuda hi, ushema minna: chumera it leh, kulla let leh.

Veod amar rav ashe, ta shema: "vesheshet yamim" – yachol ben retzufin uven mefuzzarin? talmud lomar: "shishshim", ma shishshim kullan retzufin – af shishsha kullan retzufin. manni? illema rabbanan, mi it lehu lerabbanan mefuzzarin? haamri rabbanan: levalad sheni manya!
Ella lav rabbi yehuda hi, ushema minna: chumera it leh, kulla let leh? shema minna.
Mishna ellu meviin korban ole veyored: al shemiat kol, veal bittuy sefatayim, veal tumeat mikdash vekadashav, vehayyoledet, vehametzora.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: yesh mevi bedallut vaashirut, veyesh mevi bedallut veyesh mevi bedalle dallut:
Yoledet – mevia bedallut vaashirut. metzora – mevi bedallut. shemiat hakkol uvittuy sefatayim vetumeat mikdash vekadashav – meviin bedallut vedalle dallut.
Tanya iddach: yesh mevi echad tachat echad, yesh mevi shenayim tachat shenayim, yesh mevi shenayim tachat echad, yesh mevi echad tachat shenayim, mikkan atta lamed laasirit haefa bifruta.

Yoledet mevia achat tachat achat – perida achat vaof tachat keves, metzora – shete feridin tachat shene chevasim, shemiat hakkol uvittuy sefatayim vetumeat mikdash vekadashav – meviin shete feridin tachat kivsa achat, umeviin bedalle dallut asirit haefa tachat shete feridin.
Katane: mikkan atta lamed laasirit haefa shehi bifruta. menalan? detanu rabbanan: haomer "hare alay besela lammizbeach" – mevi keves, sheen davar karev besela ella keves.
Mimmay? middeamar rachamana "el asham bechesef shekalim", mikkelal decheves ben shana besela, middichtiv "keves ben shenato". utenan: amdu kinnin bo bayyom berivatayim.
Umiddechas rachamana aleh dedallut lemihve chad mishshet asar baashirut, chas rachamana aleh dedalle dallut lemihve chad mishshet asar bedallut.
Im ken, dallut kema havya – riva, uchema perite beriva – arbaim utemanya perite, chad mishshet asar kema have dedallut – telata perite.
Dekatane: mikkan atta lamed laasirit haefa bifruta, ammay peruta? haamrat: asirit haefa dalle dallut hu, veamrat chad mishshet sere dedallut hu, dechashvinan ditlata perite havayin!

Tanna miyyoledet yalef, dematya perida achat tachat keves, dehave chad mittelatin uteren decheves. vead kan, dalle dallut kema have – chad mishshet asar bedallut, demehecha yalef – mikkeves veayil. ad kan, peruta ufalga have!

Amar rava: kulla milleta miyyoledet yalef, vehachi kaamar: middechas rachamana aleh dedallut lemihve chad mittelatin uteren baashirut, umay hi – yoledet, hachi chas rachamana aleh dedalle dallut lemihve chad min telatin uteren bedallut.
I hachi, neche riva difruta have! hachi name, ella delav orach ara leetoye pachot mipperuta lammakom.
Mishna ma ben shifcha leven kol haarayot? shello shavvta lahen lo baonesh velo bakkorban. shekkol haarayot bechattat, veshifcha beasham. kol haarayot binkeva, veshifcha bezachar.
Kol haarayot echad haish veechad haishsha shavin bammakkot uvakkorban, uvashshifcha lo hishva lo haish laishsha bammakkot, velo hishva ishsha laish bakkorban.
Kol haarayot asa bahen et hameare kegomer, vechayyayv al kol bia uvia.
(Zo chomer) hechmir beshifcha,

a: Sheasa bah et hammezid kashshogeg.

Ezo shifcha? kol shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin, shenneemar: "vehofde lo nifdata", divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yishmael omer: zo hi shifcha vaddait. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kol arayot meforashot, veshiyyur en lanu ella chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin.
Gemara menalan dehi lakya[1] vehu la lake? detanu rabbanan: "bikkoret tihye" – melammed shehi loka. yachol shenehen lokin? talmud lomar: "tihye" – hi loke vehu eno loke.

Uminnayin dehaden "bikkoret" lishshana demalkut hu? amar rabbi yitzchak: "tehe bekarae", kidtanya: gedol haddayyaynin makri, sheni mone, shelishi omer: hakkehu. rav ashe omar: "bevikkur tihye", keditnan: en omdin oto ella makkot haruyot lehishtallesh.

Tanu rabbanan: bizman shehaishsha loka – haish mevi korban, en haishsha loka – en haish mevi korban. menalan? amar rava, dichtiv: "veish ki yishkav et ishsha shichvat zera vehi shifcha necherefet leish vehofde lo nifdata o chufesha lo nittan lah".

Mikkedi ad hacha beish ka mishtae kera, nichtov: "vehevi et ashamo laAdonai", ulevassof lichtov "bikkoret tihye". ammay ketav rachamana beresha: "bikkoret tihye" ulevassof ketav: "vehevi et ashamo laAdonai"? hachi kaamar: im bikkoret tihye hi – "vehevi et ashamo laAdonai", veim lo tihye bikkoret – lo yavi hu et ashamo.
Ema, hu maateh kera, aval hi tilke vetayte korban! – "vehevi et ashamo laAdonai" ketiv.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: leolam eno chayyayv ella al shifcha beula bilvad, shenneemar: "vehi shifcha necherefet leish". umay mashma, dehay "necherefet" lishshana deshannoye hu? dichtiv "vattishtach alav harifot". vei baet ema: "im tichtosh haevil bammachtesh betoch harifot baeli".
"Vayyittenu yadam lehotzi neshehem vaashemim el tzon al ashmatam", amar rav chisda: melammed shekkullan shefachot charufot baalu.
Ezohi shifcha kulei. tanu rabbanan: "vehofde", yachol kullah? talmud lomar: "lo nifdata". yachol lo nifdata? talmud lomar: "vehofde",

Ha chetzad? peduya veenah peduya – chetzyah shifcha vechetzyay bat chorin umeoreset leeved ivri, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer: beshifcha kenaanit hakkatuv medabber, umeoreset leeved ivri. im ken ma talmud lomar: "vehofde lo nifdata"? dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.

Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: kol arayot meforashot lanu, meshuyyayr lanu chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin umeoreset leeved ivri. acherim omrim: "lo yumetu ki lo chuppasha" – beshifcha kenaanit hakkatuv medabber, umeoreset leeved kenaani.
Lerabbi yishmael, bishlama "vehofde lo nifdata" – kidkatane: dibbera tora chilshon bene adam, ella dekatane: meoreset leeved ivri, menalan? dichtiv: "ki lo chuppasha", mikkelal dehu chuppash.

Rabbi elazar ben azarya hayeynu rabbi akiva! lerabbi yishmael kaamar: ledidi, bealma kevotaych sevira leh dedibbera tora chilshon bene adam, vehacha shane. mikkede ketiv leh kera: "ki lo chuppasha", "vehofde lo nifdata" lema li? shema minna lehachi ata, lechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin.
Laacherim, bishlama "vehofde lo nifdata", kasavar: dibbera tora chilshon bene adam, ella ha deeved kenaani menalan? amar kera: "ki lo chuppasha", im eno inyan ledida – tenehu inyan ledideh.
Mishna kol arayot, echad gadol veechad katan – katan patur, echad er veechad yashen – yashen patur, echad shogeg veechad mezid – shogeg bechattat umezid behikkaret.
Gemara vehacha, chayyayv katan? amar rav yehuda, hachi katane: kol arayot, echad gadol veechad katan – katan patur vegadol chayyayv, vehacha – gadol name patur, may tama? deha mikkashyayn ahadade.

Kol arayot, echad neor veechad yashen – patur. vechan, yashen name chayyayv? amar rav yehuda amar rav, hachi katane: kol arayot, echad neor veechad yashen – yashen patur veneor chayyayv, vechan – afillu neor patur, may tama? demikkashyayn ahadade.
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: asu gomer kimare, mitkavven kesheen mitkavven, kedarkah keshello kedarkah, neor keyashen.

Amar leh: may kaamrat? i beshifcha charufa katane, ammay asu gomer kimare? gomer beshifcha charufa michayyayv, meare la michayyayv! vetu: mitkavven kesheeno mitkavven, i mikkavvevna – michayyeyva, i la – la michayyeyva!
Uchedarkah keshello kedarkah name, kedarkah beshifcha charufa michayyayv, veshello kedarkah la michayyayv, may tama? "shichvat zera" ketiv! umay neor keyashen?
Vei bishar arayot ka tane, asu gomer kimare?
b: Ippecha ibbei leh lemitne!
Amar leh: ismeyay? amar leh: la, hachi katane: asu gomer shello kedarkah beshifcha charufa, dela michayyeyvi, kimare kedarkah, deshichvat zera" ketiv.
Mitkavven shello kedarkah beshifcha, difturin keeno mitkavven, deshichvat zera" ketiv. neor shello kedarkah beshifcha, difturin keyashen, may tama? deshichvat zera" ketiv.
Nimtza mitkavven vehameare beshifcha, kesheen mitkavven bechol arayot. yashen kedarkah – keyashen daarayot, nimtza neor shello kedarkah beshifcha – keyashen dechol arayot.
Hadaran alach arbaa mechussere kappara
Mishna amru lo: achalta chelev – mevi chattat. ed omer: achal, veed omer: lo achal, ishsha omeret: achal, veishsha omeret: lo achal – mevi asham taluy. ed omer: achal, vehu omer: lo achalti – patur.

Shenayim omrim: achal, vehu omer: lo achalti – rabbi meir mechayyev. amar rabbi meir: im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura, lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal? amru lo: ma im yirtze lomar "mezid hayiti" – patur.

Achal chelev vechelev behelem (achat) [echad] – eno chayyayv ella achat. achal chelev vadam ufiggul venotar behelem (achat) [echad] – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. ze chomer beminin harebe mimmin echad.
Vechomer bemin echad mimminin harebe, sheim achal kachatzi zayit vechazar veachal kachatzi zayit acher behelem echad, mimmin echad – chayyayv, mishshene minin – patur.

Gemara katane: amru lo "achalta chelev" – mevi chattat. amru kema havyayn? teren. vehu ma amar lehon? illema deshatek vela kamachchesh lehu, ella shetika ditren hu demevi chattat, al shetika dechad – la.
Ema metziata, ed omer: achal, vehu omer: lo achalti. tama demachchish leh, aval shatek – michayyayv, vechol shekken tere!
Ella: dekamachchesh lehu, manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: hachechasha deve tere lav hachechasha hi, aval lerabbanan, patur.
Umay kamashma lan? missefa shamat minna! ha kamashma lan: davar ze machloket rabbi meir verabbanan, vehu dekamachchesh lehu.

Ikka deamri: "amru lo" name chad kare leh, ditnan: haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam uvau veamru lah met baalich venisset veachar kach ba balah – tetze mizze umizze, dekayyma lan daafillu bechad.
Mimmay? middekatane sefa: nisset shello birshut – mutteret lachzor lo. may shello birshut – shello birshut bet din veed echad,
Mikkelal deresha, birshut bet din uveed echad. alma gabbe ed echad katane "amru", vehacha name dekatane "amru lo", mashma afillu ed echad.
Vehu, may kaamar? illema deka machchesh leh, mi mayyte? veha katane metziata: ed echad omer: achal, vehu omer lo achalti – patur!
Ella deshatek, mimmetziata shema minna: ed echad omer: kulei. tama deka machchesh leh, aval shatek mishtak – chayyayv!
Leolam dela machchesh leh, vehachi katane: amru lo: achalta chelev – mevi chattat. bamme devarim amurim: deshatek, aval machchesh leh – patur.
Umiddeorayyta menalan dela machchesh leh chayyayv? detanu rabbanan: "o hoda elav chattato" – velo sheyyodiuhu acherim. yachol afillu en machchishan? talmud lomar: "o hoda elav" – mikkol makom.
Bemay askinan? illema bitren, teren veen machchishan kera bae?

a: Ella lav bechad, vekatane ki en machchishan meheman, shema minna.
Amar rabbi meir: kal vachomer.

Ibbaya lehu: may tamayyhu derabbanan, mishshum deadam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish, o dilma mishshum deamrinan: miggo dei bae amar "mezid hayiti" – patur, ki amar name "lo achalti" – meheman ufatur?
Umay nafka minna? lemifshat minna letumea, dei amrat tamayyhu derabbanan mishshum deadam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish – la shena tumea chadasha vela shena tumea yeshana.

Vei amrat tamehon derabbanan mishshum deamar "miggo" hi – patri leh rabbanan mittumea yeshana, aval mittumea chadasha michayyayv. may tama? tumea yeshana, miggo dei bae amar "tavalti" – patur, ki amar name "lo nitmeti" – patur, deikka lememar: may "lo nitmeti" dekaamar – lo amadti betumeati ella tavalti.
Aval tumea chadasha – michayyayv, may tama? dechiy amar name "tavalti" – michayyayv, deamru leh edim: hasheta nitmeta.

May? ta shema: amar lo ed echad: nitmeta, vehu omer: lo nitmeti – patur. yachol afillu shenayim? amar rabbi meir: kal vachomer, im heviuhu shenayim lemita chamura – lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal? vachachamim omrim: adam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish. shema minna tamayyhu derabbanan mishshum deamri: adam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish.

Amar rabbi amme: leolam tama derabbanan mishshum deamrinan "miggo", vehachi katane: mittoch sheim ratza lomar: lo amadti betumeati – patur, hilkach adam neeman al atzmo yoter mimmea ish. i hachi, hayeynu chelev!

Mahu detema: "achalti chelev", kamtaretz dibbureh: la achalti shogeg ella mezid, aval: nitmeta, vehu omer: lo nitmeti, ema la kamtaretz dibbureh, ka mashma lan: hacha name: lo amadti betumeati aval tavalti.
Ta shema: "vehitvadda" – mode baddevarim – chayyayv, en mode baddevarim – patur. amar lo ed echad: nitmeta, vehu omer: lo nitmeti – patur.
Yachol afillu shenayim machchishin? amar rabbi meir: im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura, lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal? rabbi yehuda omer: neeman adam al atzmo yoter mimmea ish.
Umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bachalavin uveviat mikdash, aval betumea – la modu leh.
Bemay askinan? illema
b: Betumea yeshana, may shena chalavin uviat mikdash demodu leh, deim ratza yomar: "mezid hayiti"? tumea yeshana name metaretz dibbureh, deim ratza yomar: "lo amadti betumeati ella tavalti"!

Amar ravina: leolam betumea yeshana, uchegon deamri leh edim: achalta kadashim betumeat hagguf, vehu amar lehon: "lo nitmeti", dehacha la metaretz dibbureh. delekka lememar lo amadti betumea aval tavalti,
May amar lehon? "tavalti veachalti", ki amar lehon hachi, ittachchash leh dibbureh kamma miha betumeat maggao!
Amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar rav yosef: lo amarah [rabbi yehuda] ella beno leven atzmo uleatzmo.
Amar resh lakish: mode rabbi meir lachachamim, sheim amru lo shenayim: baalta shifcha charufa, vehu omer: lo baalti – meheman, dei bae amar lehon: lo gamarti biati.
Amar rav sheshet: mode rabbi meir lachachamim benazir tame, sheamru lo shenayim: nitmeta, vehu omer: lo nitmeti – patur, dei bae amar: nishalti al nizyri.
Amar abbaye: mode rabbi meir lachachamim, sheim amru lo shenayim: yodea atta beedut peloni, vehu omer: lo yadati – patur, dei bae amar: lo nitkavvavnti leedut.
Achal chelev vachelev behelem (achat) [echad]. matkef la rabbi zera: ammay eno chayyayv ella chattat achat veha shene zete chelev achal!
Amar leh abbaye: helemot mechullakot, vehacha helem echad hu deikka.
Ikka demakshe leh hachi: tama dehelem echad, ha bishte helemot chayyayv shetayim. ammay? shem chelev echad hu! amar leh abbaye: helemot mechullakin.
Achal chelev vadam piggul venotar – chayyayv kulei.
Mimmin echad chayyayv, peshita! amar resh lakish mishshum bar tuteni: kegon sheachalo bishne tamchuyin, veallibba derabbi yehoshua: deamar tamchuyin mechullakin.
Mahu detema: ki amar rabbi yehoshua – la shena lekulla, vela shena lechumera. ka mashma lan dechayyayv, alma: lechumera amar, lekulla la amar.
Ikka deamar al sefa: mishshene minin – patur. peshita! amar resh lakish mishshum bar tuteni: kegon sheachalo bishne tamchuyin, veallibba derabbi yehoshua: deamar tamchuyin mechullakin.
Demahu detema: ki amar rabbi yehoshua – lechumera amar, lekulla la amar. ka mashma lan: mishshene minin patur.
May mishshene minin? mimmin echad hu, veammay kare leh shene minim – mishshum daachalo bishne tamchuyin, vekatane: patur, alma la shena lekulla vela shena lechumera kaamar rabbi yehoshua.
Middesefa min echad ushene tamchuyin, resha min echad vetamchuy echad. peshita!
Amar ravina: kegon shehayta lo yedia bentayim, veallibba derabban gamliel, deamar: en yedia lachatzi shiur.
Ditnan: hakkotev shete otiyyot bishte helemot, achat shacharit veachat arvit – rabban gamliel michayyayv, vachachamim potrin.
Rabban gamliel savar: en yedia lachatzi shiur, verabbanan savri: yesh yedia lachatzi shiur.
Mishna kamma yishhe baochalin? keillu ochel kelayot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyishhe mittechilla vead sof kede achilat peras – chayyayv.
Achal ochalin temein veshata mashkin temein, shata reviit yayin venichnas lammikdash veshaha kede achilat peras – chayyayv, rabbi elazar omer: im pasek bah o im natan bo mayim kol shehu – patur.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: rabbi meir, lechumera kaamar o lekulla kaamar? lechumera kaamar, vehachi katane: keillu ochel kelayot, daafillu kulleh yoma. veaf al gav demittechilla vead sof yoter mikkede achilat peras, kevan dimshicha achilteh – michayyayv. vaamaru leh rabbanan: dead sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras hu dechayyayv yoter mikkede achilat peras – patur.

O dilma lekulla kaamar, dehachi katane: keillu ochel kelayot, vehu dela ayfsek bene uvene, aval deayfsek bene uvene, af al gav demittechilla vead sof bichde achilat peras – patur. veamru leh rabbanan: kevan demittechilla vead sof bichde achilat peras hu – chayyayv?
Ta shema: vachachamim omrim: ed sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras mittechilla vead sof.

a: I amrat bishlama rabbi meir lechumera, hayeynu dekatane: "ad sheyyishhe", ad dishhiyya[5] dileh kede achilat peras.
Ella i amrat rabbi meir lekulla, "vachachamim omrim: im shaha" mibbee leh! ella lav shema minna: rabbi meir lechumera? shema minna.
Amar ravnay amar shemuel: bachalavim uvinvela ad sheyyishhe mittechilla vead sof bichde achilat peras. ochalim temeim, shekatzim uremasim umashkin – afillu kol hayyom kullo bichde achilat peras.
May kaamar? amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: afillu kol hayyom kullo, vehu sheachal kezayit bichde achilat peras.
Metivi: kol haochalin mitztarfin lifsol haggeviyyay bechachatzi feras – may lav deachleh lachatzi feras bichde achilat peras? la, daachal kezayit kezayit bichde achilat peras.

Metivi: kol haochalin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyyay bechachatzi feras bichde achilat peras, ketzad? achal vechazar veachal, im yesh mittechillat achila rishona vead sof achila acharona kede achilat peras – mitztarfin, yoter mikkan – en mitztarfin.
Lo hittiru leechol pachot mikkeshiur lered velitbol, yarad vetaval veala vehishlimo – mitztaref. hittiru lah laubbara leechol pachot mikkeshiur, mippene hassakkana.

Kol hammashkin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyyay birviit bichde achilat peras. ketzad? shata vechazar veshata, im yesh mittechillat shetiyya rishona vead sof shetiyya acharona kede achilat peras – mitztarfin, yoter mikkan – en mitztarfin.
Hittiru lah lemagga teme met lehanik benah, uvenah tahor.
Katane mihat: im yesh mittechillat achila rishona vead sof achila bichde achilat peras – mitztaref. teyuveta deravnay, teyuveta.
Amar mar: lo hittiru lo leechol pachot mikkeshiur lered velitbol. may kaamar?

Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: achal pachot mikkeshiur – lo hittiru lo lered velitbol, sheim yarad vetaval veala vehishlimo – mitztaref. veate lememar: ahani li tevila kammayyta, veen yodea sheen tevila ella baacharona.

Katane: hittiru lah laubbara leechol pachot mikkeshiur mippene hassakkana. mippene hassakkana afillu tuva name techol! amar rav pappa, hachi katane: hittiru lah laubbara pachot mikkeshiur, afillu tuva, mippene hassakkana.
Katane: hittiru lemagga teme met lehanik et benah, uvenah tahor – ammay tahor? kevan diynak chalav ittammi leh mechalav!
Vechi tema: la ittachshar – nittachshar betippa meluchelechet al pi haddad! amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: bitkifa achat, lo hinniach tippa meluchelechet al pi haddad.
Amar rava: shete teshuvot baddavar: chada, dekachazena lefummeh deyanoka dimle chalav! veod, mekom chalav mayayn hu.
Dekatane: chalev ishsha metamme ben leratzon uven shello leratzon, (behema enah metamme ella leratzon.)
May lav "shello leratzon" – dela nicha leh, vekatane: "metamme"?
Ella amar rava: hayeynu tama divnah tahor – desafek yanak kashshiur vesafek lo yanak, veim timtza lomar yanak, safek yenako baachilat peras, sefek yenako beyoter mikkede achilat peras.
Ulerava, mekom chalav mayayn hu, velo tzarich hechsher?
Vehatnan: haishsha shennataf chalav middaddeha venafal laavir tannur – tannur tame. vekashya lan: bemay ittachshar? veamar rabbi yochanan: betippa meluchelechet al pi haddad.
Vechi tema, rava la savar la kerabbi yochanan, vehatanya: nimtzeta atta omer, tisha mashkin bezov: hazzea, velecha serucha, verei – tehorin mikkelum. dimat eno, vedam maggefato,
b: Vachalev ishsha – metammein tumeat mashkin birviit. rukko, zovo, umeme raglav – metammein tumea chamura, bechol shehu.
Vei amrat mekom chalav meayyen [hu], chalav name netamme tumea chamura bechol shehu, kezovo verukko! ella shema minna: mekom chalev ishsha lav mayayn hu.
I hachi, kashya ha matnita veamar rava: "metamme ben leratzon uven shello leratzon"!
Mi savrat "shello leratzon" deamar – dela nicha leh? la, may "shello leratzon" deamar, dedateh detinok kariva legabbe chalav, aval amar la nicha leh – tahor.

Achal ochalin temein vechulei. lema li shehiyyay, dekatane: veshaha? amar rav yehuda, hachi katane: achal ochalin temein, veshata mashkin temein, veshata reviit yayin, veshaha baachilatan uvishtiyyaytan kede achilat peras, venichnas lammikdash – chayyayv.
Rabbi elazar omer kulei. tanu rabbanan: "yayin veshechar al tesht" – yachol afillu kol shehu, afillu miggitto?
Talmud lomar: "veshechar" – en asur ella kede leshakker, vechamma kede leshakker? reviit yayin ben arbaim yom.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "yayin"? lomar lecha shemmuzeharin alav kol shehu, umuzeharin alav miggitto.
Rabbi yehuda omer: "yayin" – en li ella yayin, shear meshakkerin minnayin? talmud lomar: "veshechar". im ken, ma talmud lomar: "yayin"? al hayyayin – bemita, veal shear mashkin – beazhara.
Rabbi elazar omer: "yayin al tesht veshechar" – al tishtehu kederech shichruto, ha im hifsik bo, o natan letocho mayim kol shehu – patur.
Bemay feligi? tanna kamma savar: gamrinan "shechar" "shechar" minnazir.
Verabbi yehuda la yalef "shechar" "shechar" minnazir. verabbi elazar savar: may "shechar"? midde dehu meshakker.

Keman azla ha detanya: achal devela keilit, veshata devash o chalav, venichnas lammikdash veshimmesh – loke, keman? kerabbi yehuda. amar rav yehuda bar achotay: halacha kerabbi elazar. vekare rav aleh derabbi elazar: "tuveyana dechakkime".
Rav acha dehutzal hava nidra ala devethu, ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: zil haiddana veta limchar, derav la moke amora aleh miyyoma tava lechavreh mishshum shichrut.
Amar leh, vehaamar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar, umar hu deka rame beh mayya! amar leh, ha la kashya: ha birviit, ha beyoter mikkede reviit.
Tanu rabbanan: "ulehavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol" – ellu damin vaarachin, charamin vehekdeshot.
"Ben hattame uven hattahor" – ellu temaot uteharot. "ulehorot" – zo horaa. "et kol hachukkim" – ellu midrashot. "asher devar Adonai" – zo halacha. "beyad moshe" – ze talmud.
Yachol af hammishna? talmud lomar: "ulehorot". rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: yachol af talmud? talmud lomar: "ulehorot".

Keman azla ha detanya: yatza sheretz tame, utzefardea tahor, sheshshetuye yayin morin bahen horaa. nema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, vela rabbanan? – afillu tema rabbanan, veshane hacha, dezil keri be rav hu.

Amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda. veha rav la mokem amora miyyoma tava lechavreh mishshum shichrut! shane rav, deori more. venoykem (dela) [vela] lore! – kol hecha deyatev rav la saggi leh bela horaa.
Mishna yesh ochel achila achat vechayyayvin aleha arbaa chattaot veasham echad: tame sheachal chelev, vehaya notar min hammukedashin, beyom hakkippurim.
Rabbi meir omer: im haya shabbat vehotzio – chayyayv. amru lo: eno min hashshem.

a: Gemara nema it leh lerabbi meir issur chal al issur? nehi deissur chal al issur let leh, issur kolel veissur mosif it leh.
Tahor, meikkara la asir ella bechelev, hava leh tame, miggo daasir bachatichot tehorot – ittosaf beh name issura illave chelev.
Vechelev meikkara la asir ella baachila, akdesheh, miggo deittosaf beh issura dahanaa – ittosaf beh legabbe chelev.

Veakkatti lehedyot hu daasir aval legavoah shere, hava leh notar, miggo deittosaf issura legabbe gavoah – ittosaf beh legabbe hedyot. chal aleh yom hakkippurim, miggo deittosaf beh issur legabbe chullin – ittosaf beh legabbe gavoah.
Venitne: chamesh chattaot, venokma kegon daachal kezayit piggul! bachada behema kamayyre, bishte behemot la kamayyre, venotar ufiggul bachada behema la mashkachat la.
Allema la? mashkachat la kegon sheheela ever piggul legabbe mizbeach, defaka pigguleh minneh vehave leh notar,
Vechidamar ulla: kometz piggul sheheela legabbe mizbeach – paka piggulo mimmennu vehave leh notar. beever echad ka mayyre, bishne evarim la kamayyre, venotar ufiggul bechad ever la mashkachat la.

Allema la? mashkachat la kegon sheheela ever piggul legabbe mizbeach, defalgeh annecheh al gabbe mizbeach, ufalgeh meabbaray demizbeach, dehahu demizbeach paka piggul vahava leh notar, vechidamar ulla: kometz piggul sheheela al hammizbeach – paka piggulo mimmennu vehave leh notar!
Amar leh: la, i rubba demizbeach – shidyeh lammizbeach, rubba devaray – shidyeh levaray.
Tifshot devae rame bar chama: halchu beevarim achar harov o lo! ella, bichzayit echad kamayyre, bishne zetim la ka mayyre.
Vela? vehakatane "yom hakkippurim", uveyom hakkippurim kotevet [hu] demichayyayv, vechotevet it bay shene zetim!
Amar rabbi zera: kegon sheachal kuleya bechelbah. rav pappa amar: kegon demalleyeh betamre.
Rav adda bar acha matne "chamesh chattaot", umetaretz la: kegon daachal kezayit piggul, vela meshanne kehane shinnuye deka meshannenan.
Venitne: "shesh chattaot", venokma kegon daachal kezayit dam! bachada achila ka mayyre, bishte achilot lo ka mayyre, veshiaru chachamim deen bet habbelia machazik yoter mishshene zetim.
Rabbi meir omer vechulei. venitne: "im hotzio – chayyayv", may tama katane "im hayta shabbat"? amar rafram: zot omeret: eruv vehotzaa leshabbat, veen eruv vehotzaa leyom hakkippurim.
Mimmay? dilma yesh eruv vehotzaa leyom hakkippurim, vehachi katane: im hayta shabbat vehotzio – chayyayv af mishshum shabbat veyom hakkippurim!
Ella i ittemar derafram al hada ittemar, detanya: "veshillach beyad ish itti", "ish" – lehacheshir et hazzar. "itti" – afillu betumea vaafillu beshabbat, "itti" – bimzumman.
Katane: "itti" – afillu beshabbat, amar rafram: zot omeret eruv vehotzaa leshabbat, veen eruv vehotzaa leyom hakkippurim.
Mimmay? shane sair hammishtalleach, dehechshero beyom hakkippurim bechach! ella derafram beruta hi.
Mishna yesh ba bia achat vechayyayv aleha shesh chattaot, ketzad? habba al bitto chayyayv aleha mishshum bitto, vaachoto, eshet achiv, veeshet achi aviv, veeshet ish, venidda.
b: Gemara veha let leh lerabbi meir issur chal al issur! nehi deissur chal al issur let leh, issur mosif veissur kolel it leh.
Kegon shebba al immo veholid bat, deissur bitto vaachoto bahade hadade ate. nisset leachiv, miggo deittosaf issur legabbe achin – ittosaf issura legabbe dideh.

Nisset laachi aviv, miggo deittosaf issura legabbe shear ache aviv – ittosaf legabbe dideh. havya la eshet ish, miggo deittosaf issur legabbe alma – ittosaf name legabbe dideh. havya la nidda, miggo deittosaf issur legabbe baala – ittosaf name legabbe dideh.

Mishna habba al bat bitto – chayyayv aleha mishshum bat bitto, vechallato, veeshet achiv, veeshet achi aviv, vaachot ishto, veeshet ish, venidda. rabbi yose omer: im avar zaken unesaah – chayyayv aleha mishshum eshet av.
Vechen habba al bat ishto, veal bat bittah.
Gemara katane: chayyayv aleha mishshum eshet av. mi sharya leh? amar rabbi yochanan: kegon shennafla lo leyibbum.
I hachi, may "avar"? amar rabbi yaakov: sheavar mishshum kallat beno, sheniyya.
Kidtanya: kallato erva, kallat beno sheniyya. vechen atta motze bevat beno, uvevat ben beno. ad sof kol haddorot.
Umi it leh lerabbi yose issur chal al issur? veha tenan: avar avera sheyyesh bah shete mitot – niddon bachamura. rabbi yose omer: niddon bezikka rishona shebbaa alav.
Vetanya: ketzad amar rabbi yose niddon bezikka rishona? chamoto venaaset eshet ish – niddon mishshum chamoto.
Eshet ish venaaset chamoto – niddon mishshum eshet ish!
Amar rabbi avahu: mode rabbi yose beissur mosif. vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: mode rabbi yose beissur mosif.
May issur mosif ikka hacha? deikka bera lesava, miggo deittosaf issura legabbe bereh – ittosaf issura legabbe dideh.
Mishna habba al chamoto chayyayv aleha mishshum chamoto, vechallato, veeshet achiv, veeshet achi aviv, vaachot ishto, veeshet ish, venidda. vechen habba al em chamiv, veal em chamoto.
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: habba al chamoto chayyayv aleha mishshum chamoto, veem chamoto, veem chamiv. amru lo: sheloshtan shem echad hen.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: rabbi yochanan ben nuri vesomchos amru davar echad. rabbi yochanan ben nuri – ha daamaran. somchos may hi? ditnan:

a: Shechatah veet bat bittah, veachar kach shachat et bittah – sofeg et haarbaim. somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: sofeg shemonim.
Amar rava: dilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri hacha ella mishshum shemot muchelakin, demikkarya chamoto, umikkarya em chamoto, umikkarya em chamiv.
Aval gabbe oto veet beno, dechullehu "oto veet beno" mikkaryayn, deen shemot muchelakin – la.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: dilma ad kan la kaamar somchos ella gabbe oto veet beno, degufin muchelakin.
Aval hacha, deen gufin muchelakin, ema kerabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan sevira leh, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: "shaara henna zimma hi", hakkatuv asaan lechullan zimma achat.

Mishna amar rabbi akiva: shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua baitles shel emaum, shehalchu likkach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel, habba al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo, mahu? chayyayv achat al kullan, o chayyayv al kol achat veechat?
Amru lo: lo shamanu, aval shamanu: habba al chamesh nashav niddot behelem (achat) [echad], shehu chayyayv al kol achat veechat, (veroe ani) [veroin anu] shehaddevarim kal vachomer.
Gemara hechi dame? illema kidkatane, may tibbee leh? hare shemot muchelakin, hare gufin muchelakin!
Ella hachi katane: habba al achot aviv shehi achot immo, chayyayv achat al kullan, o chayyayv al kol achat veechat, mahu? mi amrinan: hare shemot muchelakin, o dilma hare en gufin muchelakin?
Amru lo: lo shamanu, aval shamanu: habba al chamesh nashav niddot bevat achat, shehu shem echad, shechayyayv al kol achat veachat mishshum nidda,

Verainu shehaddevarim kal vachomer: uma habba al chamesh nashav niddot bevat achat, shehi shem achat – chayyayv al kol achat veachat, achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo, shehen shelosha shemot – eno din sheyyehe chayyayv al kol achat veachat?
Ikka lemifrach: ma lechamesh niddot – shekken gufin muchelakin!
Ella amar kera: "ervat achoto gilla", lechayyev al achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo.

Amar rav adda bar ahava: mashkachat la berashshia bar rashshia, shebba al immo veholid shete banot, vechazar uva al achat mehen veholid ben, uva beno al achot immo, shehi achoto, shehi achot aviv, dehave leh rashshia bar rashshia.
Tanu rabbanan: ba aleha, vechazar uva aleha, vechazar uva aleha – chayyayv al kol achat veechat, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: eno chayyayv ella echat.
Umodim chachamim lerabbi eliezer beva al chamesh nashav niddot bevat achat, shehu chayyayv al kol achat veachat, hoil vehu garam lahen.
Amar rava lerav nachman: mi amrinan "hoil vehu garam lahen"? vehatanya: hu behelem (achat) [echad] vehi bachamishsha helemot – hu eno chayyayv ella achat vehi chayyevet al kol achat veechat.
Ella ema: hoil vegufin muchelakin.
Ibbaya lehu, katzar vekatzar – ma li amar rabbi eliezer?
Tama derabbi eliezer hatam mishshum dehu daavad tarten, veammetul (30)hachi amar: chayyayv al kol achat veachat, vehacha name daavad tarten,

O dilma tameh derabbi eliezer hatam mishshum dei efshar lo learvan leviot zo bazo, ammetul (l)hachi amar rabbi eliezer: chayyayv al kol achat veachat, aval katzar kigrogeret vechazar vekatzar kigrogeret behelem (achat) [echad], kevan deefshar lo learev shete gerogrot bevat achat eno chayyayv ella echat, may?

Amar rabba: tama derabbi eliezer hatam – mishshum daavad tarte, hacha name ha avad tarte. verav yosef amar: tama derabbi eliezer hatam – dei efshar lo learvan, aval efshar lo learvan – eno chayyayv ella echat.
Etiveh abbaye lerabba: rabbi eliezer mechayyev al valde melachot bimkom avot melachot.
Ha av veav, bevat achat – patur. vei amrat tama derabbi eliezer mishshum dekaaved tarte, ammay patur?
Amar mar bereh derabbanan: ana verav nechumi bar zecharya targemna: hacha vemay askinan –
Bedalit hammudelet al gabbe teena uketzatzan bevat achat, mishshum hachi mechayyev rabbi eliezer, hoil veshemot muchelakin vegufin muchelakin.
Dichvota katzar vekatzar, hechi mashkachat la demippetar? kegon shekkatzar shete gerogrot bevat achat, aval katzar kigrogeret vechazar vekatzar kigrogeret – chayyayv.
Mishna veod shaal rabbi akiva: ever hameduvldal babbehema, mahu? amru lo: lo shamanu, aval shamanu ever hameduvldal baadam shehu tahor, vechach hayu
b: Mukke shechin osin birushalayim, holech lo erev pesach etzel harofe, vechotcho ad shemmanniach bo kesaara, vetochavo besira, venimshach mimmennu,
Vehalla, ose pischo veharofe ose pischo, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer.
Gemara tenan hatam: hammochek et hakkeresha, vehassochet bisaro uvichsuto – mashkin shebbetocho enam bechi yuttan", vehayyotzin mimmennu hare hen bechi yuttan".
Amar shemuel: ucheresha atzmah hucheshra, may tama? bishat perisha mimmennu hucheshra.
Vehatnan: erev pesach holech lo etzel kulei. vei amrat bishat perishatan hucheshar, ha ikka name hahu ever hameduledal, bishat perishato meadam – netammeyeh leadam!
Kidkaamar rav yosef: benittazin bechol kochan, hacha name, benittazin bechol kochan.

Vehecha ittemar derav yosef? aha: zav uteme met shehayu mehallechim veyardu alehem geshamim, af al pi shessochatin ze et ze, mashkin hayyordin mitztzad haelyon letzad hattachton – tehorim, sheen mechashshevin ella sheyyatzu mikkullan.
Yatzu mikkullan – hare machshirin, sheen nechshavin ella leachar sheyyatzu miggufo. amar rav yosef: benittazin bechol kochan.
Mishna veod (shaalu) [sheelan] rabbi akiva: hashshochet chamishsha zevachim bachutz behelem (achat) [echad] mahu? chayyayv al kol achat veachat, o achat al kullan? amru lo: lo shamanu.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati beochel mizzevach echad mechamishsha tamchuyin behelem achat shehu chayyayv al kol achat veachat mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer.
Amar rabbi shimon: lo kach shaal(6) rabbi akiva, ella beochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem (achat) [echad] mahu? chayyayv achat al kullan, o chayyayv al kol achat veechat? amru lo: lo shamanu.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati beochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyin behelem (achat) [echad] shehu chayyayv al kol achat veachat mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: im halacha – nekabbel, im ladin – yesh teshuva. amar lo: hashev.
Amar: velo im amarta bimila, sheasa bah et hammaachil kaochel veet hamehanne kannehene,
Tzeref et hammeila lizman merubbe, tomar benotar, sheen bo achat meellu.
Gemara may kashya leh lerabbi shimon? hachi ka kashya leh: ma reaya leshochet meochel? ma leochel shekken nehene!
Ella kach (shaalu) [sheelan]: haochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem (achat) [echad], mahu? chayyayv bechol achat veachat, o achat al kullan? amru lo: lo shamanu.

Amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati beochel mizzevach echad mechamishsha tamchuyin behelem (achat) [echad] shechayyayv al kol achat veachat mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer – ma mizzevach echad sheen gufin muchelakin chayyayv al kol achat veachat mishshum tamchuyin muchelakin, chamishsha zevachim degufin muchelakin lo kol shekken?

Amar rabbi shimon: lo kach shaal(6), ella beochel (mizbeach echad) notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem (achat) [echad], mahu? chayyayv achat al kullan, o chayyayv al kol achat veechat? amru lo: lo shamanu.

Rabbi yehoshua omer: shamati beochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyin, shehu chayyayv al kol achat veachat mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer. amar lo rabbi akiva: im halacha nekabbel kulei

Kaybla rabbi yehoshua leha teshuva merabbi akiva o la? ta shema, detanya: achal chamesh chatichot notar mizzevach echad behelem (achat) [echad] bachamishsha tamchuyin – eno mevi ella chattat achat, veal lo hoda shellahen eno mevi ella asham taluy.

Mechamishsha tamchuyin bachamishsha[5] helemot – mevi chattat al kol achat veechat, veal lo hoda shellahen mevi asham taluy al kol achat veachat. mechamishsha zevachim behelem (achat) [echad] – chayyayv.

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: afillu achal chamesh chatichot mechamishsha zevachim behelem (achat) [echad] – eno mevi ella chattat echat, veal sefekan en mevi ella asham taluy echad. kelalo shel davar: kol shechalukin bechattaot – chalukin baashamot.
Achal chamesh chatichot bachamishsha tamchuyin mizzevach echad lifne zerikat damim, afillu behelem (achat) [echad] – chayyayv al kol achat veachat mishshum meila.

a: Veillu al sefeko, mevi asham taluy la katane. manni ha? ilema rabbi akiva, litne name sefa: "veal sefekan mevi asham taluy", dehatnan: rabbi akiva mechayyev al sefek meila asham taluy!
Ella lav rabbi yehoshua hi, vekatane: "bachamishsha helemot – mevi chamesh chattaot", ushema minna: kaybla minneh!
Ella adderabba, missefa, dekatane: mechamishsha zevachim afillu behelem (achat) [echad] – chayyayv al kol achat veechat, shema minna: la kaybla minneh!
Veella may it [lach] lememar, tannae hi, deikka tanna dekaybla veikka tanna dela kaybla?
Afillu tema rabbi akiva hi, vehay tanna savar la kevateh bachada ufelig aleh bachada, savar la kevateh behaalama, ufelig aleh bimilot.
Hechi dame chamesh meilot? amar shemuel: keotah sheshshaninu: chamishsha devarim baola mitztarfin: habbasar, vehechalav, vehayyayin, vehassolet, vehashshemen.

Chizkiyya amar: kegon sheachal mechamishsha evarim. resh lakish amar: afillu tema beever echad, mashkachat la bechatef. rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: kegon sheachal bachamishsha mine kedera. rabbi yochanan amar: kegon sheachal bachamishsha teamim.
Mishna amar rabbi akiva: shaalti et rabbi eliezer beose melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe meen melacha achat behelem (achat) [echad], mahu? chayyayv achat al kullan, o chayyayv al kol achat veechat?

Amar lo: chayyayv al kol achat veachat, mikkal vachomer, uma nidda sheen bah totzaot harebe vechattaot harebe – chayyayv al kol achat veechat, shabbat sheyyesh bah totzaot harebe umitot harebe – eno din sheyyehe chayyayv al kol achat veechat?
Amarti lo: im amarta bannidda sheyyesh bah shete azharot, shehu muzehar al hannidda vehannidda muzeheret alav, tomar bashshabbat, sheen bah ella azhara echat!
Amar li: habba al hakketannot yochiach, sheen bah ella azhara achat, vechayyayv al kol achat veechat!
Amarti lo: im amarta bakketannot, sheaf al pi sheen bahen achshav – yesh bahen leachar zeman, tomar bashshabbat, sheen bah achshav velo leachar zeman?
Amar li: habba al habbehema yochiach! amarti lo: habbehema kashshabbat.
Gemara may kavae minneh? i shabbatot kegufin damyayn vei la bae minneh, nive: haose melacha achat beshabbatot harebe!
Ella: valde melachot i keavot damyayn vei la bae minneh, nive minneh: haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat bashshabbat!
Amar rava: amri be rav, tarte bea minneh: shabbatot kegufin damyayn vei la bea minneh, valde melachot kimlachot damyayn i la.
Veshabbatot, hechi mibbee leh? shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot – peshita leh deyamim shebbentayim havyayn yedia lechallek,
Uzedon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae minneh, i kegufin damyayn i la,
O dilma, zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot – peshita leh dichgufin damyayn, veshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot hu devae minneh, deyamim shebbenatayim i havyayn yedia lechallek i la?
Amar rabba:
b: Mistabbera shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot peshita leh deyamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek, uzedon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae minneh – kegufin damyayn, o lav.
Ufeshayt leh dizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot kegufin damyayn, vela kabbel minneh. ufeshat leh, devalde melachot kimlachot damyayn, vela kabbel minneh.
Amar rabba: mena amena la? ditnan, kelal gadol amru bashshabbat: kol hashshocheach ikkar shabbat, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe – eno chayyayv ella achat.

Hayyodea ikkar shabbat, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe – chayyayv al kol shabbat veshabbat. hayyodea shehu shabbat veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe – chayyayv al kol av melacha umelacha.
Veillu "chayyayv al kol av melacha shel kol shabbat veshabbat" la katane.
Manni ha? ilema rabbi eliezer, ema sefa: haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat – en chayyayv ella echat, vei rabbi eliezer – chayyayv al kol valde melachot kimlachot!
Ella peshita rabbi akiva hi, ushema minna shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot peshita leh deyamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek,
Zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae i kegufin damyayn, ufeshat leh dichgufin damyayn, valde melachot kimlachot damyayn, vetarvayyhu la kabbel minneh.

Amar leh abbaye: leolam ema lach zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot peshita leh lerabbi akiva deshabbatot lav kegufin damyayn, veshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot hu devae minneh, deyamim shebbentayim mi havayin yedia lechallek o la.
Ufeshayt leh deyamim shebbentayim [havayin yedia] lechallek vekabbel minneh, ufeshat leh valde melachot kimlachot damayin vela kabbel minneh.

Rav chisda amar: zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot – afillu rabbi akiva sevira leh dichgufin damyayn, vechi bae minneh, shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot hu devae minneh, deyamim shebbentayim i havyayn yedia lechallek.
Ufeshayt leh yamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek, vekabbel minneh.
Ufeshat leh devalde melachot kimlachot damayin, vela kabbel minneh.

Amar rav chisda: mena amena la? detanya: hakkotev shete otiyyot behelem echad – chayyayv. bishte helemot – rabban gamliel mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. umode rabban gamliel, sheim katav ot achat beshabbat zo veot achat beshabbat acheret – patur.

Vetanya achariti: hakkotev shete otiyyot bishte shabbatot, echad beshabbat zo veechad beshabbat zo – rabban gamliel mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. ka salka datach, derabban gamliel kerabbi akiva sevira leh.
Bishlama ledidi, deamena zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot afillu rabbi akiva omer deshabbatot kegufin damyayn, ha detanya patur – bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot, deshabbatot kegufin damyayn.

a: Veha detanya chayyayv – beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot (deshabbatot kegufin damyayn), dekasavar: en yedia lachatzi shiur.
Ella lerava, deamar: sevira leh lerabbi akiva deshabbatot keguf echad hen,
Bishlama ha detanya chayyayv, mashkachat la ben bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot, deshabbatot keguf echad hen, uven beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot, dekasavar: en yedia lachatzi shiur.
Veella hadtanya patur, bemay mokmat la? la bachada vela bachada!
Amar lach rava: rabban gamliel sevira leh kerabbi eliezer, deamar: shabbatot kegufin damyayn.

Veha middekatane: umode rabban gamliel, mikkelal difligi aachranyayta. i amrat bishlama kerabbi akiva sevira leh – hayeynu difligi beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot, derabban gamliel savar: en yedia lachatzi shiur.
Umode rabban gamliel bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot shehu patur, alma shabbatot kegufin damyayn. ella i amrat rabban gamliel kerabbi eliezer sevira leh, mikkelal difligi. bemay?

I beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot – afillu rabbi eliezer kerabban gamliel sevira leh deen yedia lachatzi shiur, detanya: hakkotev shete otiyyot bishte shabbatot, ot achat beshabbat zo veot achat beshabbat zo – rabbi eliezer mechayyev!
Veella, beachat al haarig – chayyove mechayyev, ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer: haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla, veechad al haarig – chayyayv!

Amar rava: mikkelal diflig bachada, detanya: hotzi chatzi gerogeret vechazar vehotzi chatzi gerogeret behelem (achat) [echad] – chayyayv. bishte helemot – patur. rabbi yose omer: behelem echad birshut (echad) [achat] – chayyayv, bishte reshuyot – patur.
Derabban gamliel ketanna kamma, verabbi eliezer kerabbi yose.
Ta shema, amar lo: chayyayv al kol achat veachat mikkal vachomer, uma nidda sheen bah totzaot harebe.
