Bishlama lerav chisda deamar: shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot bae minneh, deyamim shebbentayim mi havyayn yedia lechallek o la – hayeynu dekaamar leh: "uma nidda".
Ella lerava, deamar: zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot hu devae minneh, deshabbatot i kegufin damyayn vei la – litne "niddot"!
Amar lach rava: teni "niddot". shemuel tane "nidda", rav adda bar ahava tane "nidda". rav natan bar oshaya amar: tane "niddot".
Ulerav chisda deamar: shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot hu devae minneh, deyamim shebbentayim mi havayin yedia lechallek vei la, nidda – may yamim shebbentayim havayin yedia lechallek it ba?
Amar rava: kegon shebba aleha vetavla, veraata vechazar uva aleha, vetavla, vechazar uva aleha, ditvilot havyayn keyamim shebbentayim.
Ta shema: habba al hakketannot yochiach. bishlama lerava, hayeynu dekatane "ketannot".
Ella lerav chisda, may "ketannot"? ketannot dealma.

Dela kehaden tanna, detanya: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar lo kach sheelo rabbi akiva lerabbi elazar, ella kach sheelo: habba al ishto nidda vechazar uva al ishto nidda behelem echad, mahu? chayyayv achat al kullan, o chayyayv al kol achat veachat?

Amar loy: chayyayv al kol achat veachat, mikkal vachomer, uma shabbat sheen bah ella azhara achat, shehu muzehar al hashshabbat vehashshabbat enah muzeheret alav – chayyayv al kol achat veechat, nidda sheyyesh bah shete azharot, shehu muzehar al hannidda venidda muzeheret alav – eno din shehu chayyayv al kol achat veechat?
Amru lo: lo, im amarta bashshabbat, sheyyesh bah totzaot harebe lechattaot harebe, tomar bannidda, sheen bah totzaot harebe lechattaot harebe!
Amru lo: habba al hakketannot yochiach, sheen bah totzaot harebe lechattaot harebe, vechayyayv al kol achat veechat!
Amru lo: lo, im amarta bakketannot shekken gufin muchelakin? amru lo: habba al habbehema yochiach, sheen gufin muchelakin vechayyayv al kol achat veechat! amru lo: habbehema kannidda.
Hadaran alach amru lo
Mishna safek achal chelev, safek lo achal, vaafillu achal, safek yesh bo kashshiur vesafek
b: En bo,

Shumman vachelev lefanav, veachal echad mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal, ishto vaachoto immo babbayit, shagag beachat mehen veeno yodea beezo mehen shagag, shabbat veyom chol, veasa melacha beechad mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen asa – mevi asham taluy.
Keshem sheim achal chelev vachelev behelem (achat) [echad] eno chayyayv ella chattat achat, ken al lo hoda shellahen eno mevi ella asham taluy echad.
Im hayta yedia benatayim, keshem shehu mevi chattat al kol achat veechat, kach mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat.
Keshem sheachal chelev vadam ufiggul venotar behelem achat chayyayv al kol achat veechat, kach al lo hoda shellahen mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat.
Gemara ittemar, rav assi amar: chaticha achat shaninu, safek shel chelev safek shel shumman. chiyyay bar rav amar: chaticha mishte chatichot shaninu.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rav assi savar: yesh em lammasoret, "mitzvat" ketiv.
Vechiyyay bar rav amar: yesh em lammikra, "mitzvot" karenan.
Etiveh rav huna lerav assi, veamri la chiyyay bar rav lerav assi: chelev veshumman lefanav veachal achat mehen may lav middesefa shete chatichot, resha name shete chatichot?

Amar lehu rav: la tezlu batar ippecha, deyachol leshannoye lechu: sefa bishte chatichot resha bachaticha achat. i hachi, yesh lomar: chaticha achat michayyayv, shete chatichot tzericha lememar? zo veen tzarich (lememar) [lomar] zo.

Ulechiyyay bar rav deamar: middesefa bishte chatichot, resha name bishte chatichot, mitna tarte lema li? paroshe ka mefaresh: safek achal safek lo achal chelev – mevi asham taluy, ketzad? kegon shehaya chelev veshumman lefanav.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hayu lefanav shete chatichot, achat shel shumman veachat shel chelev, achal achat mehen veeno yodea ezo mehen achal – chayyayv. chaticha achat, safek shel chelev safek shel shumman vaachalah – patur.
Amar rava: may tama derav? deamar kera: "veasa achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai bishgaga" – ad sheyyishgog bishtayim, "mitzvat" ketiv, "mitzvot" karenan.
Etiveh abbaye, rabbi eliezer omer: koy – chayyayvin alav asham taluy!
Amar lo: rabbi eliezer savar: yesh em lammasoret, "mitzvat" ketiv.
Etiveh: safek ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon – yotzi, vehavvalad kasher,
Vechayyayv beasham taluy. ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi.
Etiveh: nimtza al shello – temein, vechayyayvin bakkorban.
Al shellah otyom – temein vechayyayvin bakkorban. nimtza al shellah leachar zeman – temein missafek ufeturin min hakkorban, vetane ala: chayyayv mishshum asham taluy! ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi.

Amar rabbi chiyyay amar rav: hayu lefanav shete chatichot, achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman, veachal achat mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal – chayyayv. chaticha, safek shel shumman safek shel chelev vaachalah – patur.
Amar rabbi zera: may tama derav? kasavar: shete chatichot efshar levarer issuran, chaticha achat i efshar levarer issurah.
May ikka ben tama derava letama derabbi zera? ikka venayyhu kezayit umechetza.
Lerava – lekka "mitzvot" ufatur, lerabbi zera – efshar levarer issuro.
Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera, rabbi eliezer omer: koy, chayyayvin al chelbo asham taluy! amar leh: rabbi eliezer savar: la baenan levarer issuro.

a: Etiveh: safek ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon – yotzi, vehavvalad kasher, vechayyayv beasham taluy. ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi.

Etiveh: nimtza al shellah otyom – temein vechayyayvin bakkorban. nimtza al shellah leachar zeman – temein missafek ufeturin min hakkorban. vetane ala: vechayyayvin beasham taluy! ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi.

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: hayu lefanav shete chatichot, achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman, veachal achat mehen veeno yodea ezo mehen achal – chayyayv. chaticha, safek shel chelev safek shel shumman vaachalah – patur.
Amar rav nachman: may tama derav? kasavar: shete chatichot – ikkeva issura, chaticha achat – la (kava) [ikkeva] issura.
May ikka ben ikkeva issura leshei efshar levarer issureh?

Ikka benayyhu kegon shehayu lefanav shete chatichot, achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman, uva goy veachal et harishona, uva yisrael veachal et hashsheniyya, lerava – lekka "mitzvot" beiddana daachal yisrael. lerabbi zera – i efshar levarer issureh. lerav nachman – ikkeva issura.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: rabbi eliezer omer: koy – chayyayvin al chelbo asham taluy! rabbi eliezer la bae keviuta leissura.
Etiveh: safek ben tisha larishon, o ben shiva laacharon – yotzi vehavvalad kasher, vechayyayvin beasham taluy! ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi.

Etiveh: nimtza al shello – temein vechayyayvin bakkorban, nimtza al shellah otyom – temein vechayyayvin bakkorban, nimtza al shellah leachar zeman – temeim missafek ufeturin min hakkorban, vetane ala: vechayyayvin beasham taluy!
Ishtik. levatar dinfak amar: may tama la amari leh deha manni rabbi meir hi, dela bae keviuta leissura?
Detanya: hashshochet asham taluy bachutz – rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Veammay? lema leh derabbi eliezer hi! ha ka mashma lan, derabbi meir beshitat rabbi eliezer kae.
Amar rabba bar avu amar rav: chaticha, safek shel chelev safek shel shumman, vaachalah – banu lemachaloket rabbi eliezer vachachamim.
Lerabbi eliezer, may irya ki achla? afillu la achla name! dehatnan: rabbi eliezer omer: mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom!
Amar rav ashe: rabbi eliezer allibba devava ben buta, ditnan: ella omrim lo: hameten ad shettikkanes levet safek.

Tanu rabbanan: hayu lefanav shete chatichot, achat shel shumman veachat shel chelev, ba yisrael veachal et harishona, ba goy veachal et hashsheniyya – chayyayv, vechen kelev, vechen orev. ba goy veachal et harishona, ba yisrael veachal et hashsheniyya – patur. verabbi mechayyev.
Achal et harishona beshogeg, vehashsheniyya bemezid – chayyayv. harishona bemezid, vehashsheniyya beshogeg – patur, verabbi mechayyev. achal shetehen bemezid – patur mikkelum.
Shetehen beshogeg – shenehen chayyayvin. hashsheni lo min haddin, ella sheim atta omer patur – kavata et harishona bechattat.
Umannu? i rabbi – min haddin umin haddin hu! i rabbanan – mishshum delo nikba rishon bechattat, nema leh lesheni: ayyti chullin laazara?! amar rav ashe:
b: Rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom. hilkach, amrinan leh: ayyti asham taluy veatni: i achal rishon shumman, hu achal chelev – leheve kappara, vei la – leheve nedava.
Tanu rabbanan: achal sefek chelev venoda lo, sefek chelev venoda lo – rabbi omer: omer ani, keshem shemmevi chattat al kol achat veechat – kach mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: en mevi ella asham taluy echad, shenneemar: "al shiggato asher shagag" – afillu al shegagot harebe eno chayyayv ella echat.
Amar rabbi zera: kan shana rabbi: yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot.

Rava amar: en yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot, ella hachi katane: keshem sheim hayta lo yedia vadday mevi chattat al kol achat veachat, kach im hayta lo yediat safek mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat.
Amar leh abbaye: veat la tisbera didiot safek mechallekot lechattaot? dei salka datach yediot en mechallekot lechattaot, vechattat achat mevi, ammay mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat?
Vehatanya, kelalo shel davar: kol shechalukin bechattaot – chalukin baashamot!

Amar leh rava bar chanan leabbaye: uledidach, deamrat yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot, ella meatta, achal kezayit chelev lifne yom hakkippurim uchezayit chelev achar yom hakkippurim, veyom hakkippurim bimkom asham taluy kae – hachi name demevi shete chattaot?
Ha behelem (achat) [echad] achlinnun! amar leh abbaye: uman lema lan deyom hakkippurim mechappar al dela mityeda leh? dilma vehu demityeda leh! amar leh rava: hoda velo hoda tenan.
Ikka deamri, amar leh rava bar chanan leabbaye: ma illu achal kezayit chelev shacharit beyom hakkippurim uchezayit chelev bemincha beyom hakkippurim, hachi name demichayyayv shete chattaot?

Amar leh abbaye: uman lema lan deyom hakkippurim kol shata mechappar? dilma kulleh yoma meureta! amar leh rabba bar bar channa: terada, tanya: hare shebba leyado sefek avera beyom hakkippurim afillu im chashecha – patur, shekkol hayyom mechapper!

Metiv rav idi bar avin: achal veshata behelem (achat) [echad] – eno chayyayv ella chattat achat. veha ben achila lishtiyyay i efshar delo hava shehut bayyom, demityeyda leh vechappar leh, deyom hakkippurim bimkom asham taluy kae, vekatane: "eno chayyayv ella chattat echat".
Vei salka datach yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot, lichayyayv shete chattaot! amri: ki amar rabbi zera – lerabbi, ha – rabbanan hi.
Veha middesefa rabbi hi, dekatane: shata tzir o mureyays – patur. ha chometz – chayyayv,
Umanni? rabbi hi, detanya: chometz en meshiv et hannefesh, rabbi omer: omer ani, chometz meshiv et hannefesh. umiddesefa rabbi, resha name rabbi! amri: sefa – rabbi, resha – rabbanan.

Etiveh rava: achal hayyom achal lemachar, nehena hayyom nehena lemachar, achal hayyom nehena lemachar, nehena hayyom achal lemachar, vaafillu mikkan vead shalosh shanim, minnayin shehen mitztarfin ze im ze?
Talmud lomar: "timol maal" – ribba. veammay, ha kaypar aleh yom hakkippurim!
Amri: ki mechappar yom hakkippurim – al issura, al mamona la mechappar.
Veibbaet ema: ki mechappar yom hakkippurim – al kulleh shiura, al palga deshiura la mechappar.
Vechen amar resh lakish: kan shana rabbi: yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot. rabbi yochanan amar: en yediot safek mechallekot lechattaot,
Ella hachi katane: keshem sheim hayta lo yedia vadday mevi al kol achat veachat, kach im hayta lo yediat safek mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, hayeynu deka tale leasham bechattat. ella leresh lakish, chattat beasham mibbaya leh! kashya.
Verame derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan, verame deresh lakish. adderesh lakish, detanya: shene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor, vehalach barishon velo nichnas, bashsheni venichnas – chayyayv.
Halach barishon venichnas – patur, bashsheni venichnas – chayyayv. halach barishon venichnas, vehizza veshana vetaval, vehalach bashsheni venichnas – chayyayv.

a: Rabbi shimon poter bazo. rabbi shimon ben yehuda poter bechullan mishshum rabbi shimon.

Vaafillu bekammayyta? amar rava: hacha vemay askinan? kegon shehalach barishon uvishat hillucho bashsheni shachach shehalach barishon, uveha peligi, tanna kamma savar: miktzat yedia kidia damya, verabbi shimon savar: miktzat yedia lav kidia damya.
Amar mar: halach barishon venichnas, vehizza vetaval, vehalach bashsheni venichnas – chayyayv. ammay chayyayv? ha la havay leh yedia!
Amar resh lakish: ha manni – rabbi yishmael hi, dela bae yedia battechilla. rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan, kan asu sefek yedia kidia.
Salka datach: kan asu, vehu haddin lechol hattora kullah, kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan.
Kashya deresh lakish adderesh lakish.
Bishlama derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan la kashya: kan asu, aval bechol hattora kullah – la,
May tama? hacha, gabbe tumea ketiv: "venelam mimmennu vehu tame" – yedia deit ba name safek chayyayv kera, aval bechol hattora kullah ketiv: "o hoda elav chattato" – i it leh yedia hu demichayyayv.
Ella leresh lakish kashya, addemokem la kerabbi yishmael, lokma kerabbi! ha ka mashma lan derabbi yishmael name la bae yedia battechilla.
Ha matnitin hi! ditnan, rabbi yishmael omer: "venelam mimmennu" shete peamim – lechayyev al helem tumea veal helem mikdash!
Itzterich, salka datach amina: mikra let leh, miggemara it leh, ka mashma lan.

Mishna chelev venotar lefanav, veachal echad mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal, ishto nidda vaachoto immo babbayit, shagag beachat mehen veeno yodea beeze mehen shagag, shabbat veyom hakkippurim, veasa melacha ben hashshemashot veeno yodea beeze mehen asa – rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Amar rabbi yose: lo nechleku al haose melacha ben hashshemashot shehu patur, sheani omer: miktzat asa hayyom umiktzat asa lemachar.

Al ma nechleku? al haose melacha betoch hayyom veeno yodea im beshabbat asa im beyom hakkippurim asa, o al haose veeno yodea meen ezo melacha asa. sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yehuda: potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy.

Rabbi shimon verabbi shimon shezuri omrim: lo nechleku al davar shehu mishshem echad shehu chayyayv, al ma nechleku – al davar shehu mishshum shene shemot, sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.

Amar rabbi yehuda: afillu nitkavvevn lilkot teenim velikket anavim, anavim velikket teenim, shechorot velikket levanot, levanot velikket shechorot – rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. temehani im patar bah rabbi yehoshua. im ken, lamma neemar "asher chata bah"? perat lammitassek.

Gemara tanya, amar rabbi eliezer: ma nafshach? i chelev achal – chayyayv, i notar achal – chayyayv! i ishto nidda baal – chayyayv, i achoto baal – chayyayv! i beshabbat asa melacha – chayyayv, i beyom hakkippurim asa melacha – chayyayv!
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: hare hu omer "asher chata bah" – ad sheyyivvada lo bamme chata. verabbi eliezer, hay "bah" may aved leh? mibbee leh: perat lammitassek.
b: Mitassek demay? i dachalavim vaarayot – chayyayv, deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: hammitassek bachalavim vaarayot – chayyayv, shekken nehena!
Vei mitassek beshabbat – patur, may tama? melechet machshevet asra tora!
Lerava, mashkachat la kegon shennitkavvevn lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar. leabbaye, mashkachat la kegon denitkavvevn lehagebiah et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar.

Deittemar: nitkavvevn lehagebiah et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar – patur, may tama? deha la ikkavvavn leshum chaticha. lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar – abbaye amar: chayyayv, deha ikkavvavn leshum chaticha. rava amar: patur, deha la ikkavvavn lachaticha deissura.
Rabbi yose omer: lo nechleku kulei. tanya, amar lahen rabbi yose: dikdaktem acharay.
May amri leh daamar lehu dikdaktem acharay? hachi amaru leh: higbiah ben hashshemashot, mahu? amar lehu: dikdaktem acharay.
Venema lehu: miktzat hagebaha hayta mehayyom umiktzatah lemachar! hachi name kaamar lehu: dikdaktem acharay, velo heelitem beyedchem kelum.
Ulerabbi yose gemar melacha, lerabbi eliezer patur? ha shamana leh dimchayyev! ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla, veechad al haarig – chayyayv!
Amar rav yosef: rabbi yose allibba derabbi eliezer hachi matne, rabbi eliezer omer: haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla, ushenayim al haarig – chayyayv.

Amar rabbi yehuda: potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy, shenneemar "ki techeta velo yada" – perat laze sheyyada shechata. amar lo rabbi shimon: zehu shemmevi asham taluy, shenneemar: "veasa velo yada", veze lo yada bamme asa.
Aval safek achal chelev safek lo achal – tze usheal alav im mevi asham taluy im lav. may have ala?

Ta shema: chata velo yada bamme chata, o safek chata safek lo chata – mevi asham taluy. man shemana leh deamar: chata veen yadua bemay chata mevi asham taluy? rabbi shimon, veka tane: safek chata safek lo chata – mevi asham taluy, shema minna: sevira leh lerabbi shimon: safek chata safek lo chata – mevi asham taluy.
Rabbi shimon shezuri verabbi shimon omer lo nechleku kulei im ken, ma talmud lomar 'asher chata baAdonai"? perat lammitassek.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: mitassek bachalavim vaarayot – chayyayv, shekken nehena. mitassek bashshabbat – patur, melechet machshevet asra tora.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: veha tinokot, dechi mitassek dame, utenan: mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul bashshabbat veechad lamul achar hashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat – rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Ad kan la patar rabbi yehoshua ella mishshum dekasavar: taa bidvar mitzva velo asa mitzva – patur, aval mitassek bedavar delav mitzva – afillu rabbi yehoshua mechayyayv!
Amar lo: hannach lattinokot, hoil umekalkel bechabbura – chayyayv, mitassek bechabbura – chayyayv.

Etiveh rav yehuda lishmuel: rabbi yehuda omer: afillu mitkavven lelakket teenim velikket anavim, anavim velikket teenim, shechorot velikket levanot, levanot velikket shechorot – rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Veha hacha mitassek hu, verabbi yehoshua name la ka fatar ella min mina lemina, aval bechad mina – afillu rabbi yehoshua mechayyayv!

Amar leh: shinnana, shevok matnitin veta batray, hacha vemay askinan: kegon sheavad melakket millibbo, nitkavvevn lelakket anavim, veshachach vesavur teenim baena, vehalcha yado al haanavim, derabbi eliezer savar: hare neesta kauonato, verabbi yehoshua savar: hare lo neesta kauonato umachshavto.

a: Metiv rav oshaya: rabbi shimon shezuri verabbi shimon omrim: lo nechleku al davar shehu mishshem echad shehu chayyayv, ella al davar shehu mishshum shene shemot, sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.

Verabbi yehuda may kaamar difligi? benitkavven lelakket anavim velikket teenim, shechorot velikket levanot – anavim uteenim, shechorot ulevanot, may nihu? shene shemot? hayeynu rabbi shimon verabbi shimon shezuri! rabbi yehuda may ata leashmoinan?
Ella lav mitassek ikka benayyhu, derabbi yehuda savar: mitassek chayyayv, verabbi shimon shezuri savri: mitassek patur?
La, mitassek – divre hakkol patur, vehacha beha ka mippalgi, derabbi shimon shezuri savar: shachach melakket millibbo. beshem echad – divre hakkol chayyayv,
Ki peligi – bishne shemot. rabbi yehuda savar: la shena beshem echad vela shena bishne shemot – peligi.
Rava amar: likdom ikka venayyhu.

Vehatanya: hayu lefanav shete nerot dolkot arukkot, venitkavven lechabbot et zo vechibba et zo, lehadelik et zo vehidlik et zo – patur. lehadelik ulechabbot, vechibba vehidlik binshima achat – chayyayv.

Peshita! mahu detema: la itavid machshavteh, deha lehadelik meikkara bae ulevassof lechabbot, vechi avad maase – kibba uvassof hidlik hu, veema patur, ka mashma lan: nehi deakdome name la makdem, achore name la meachar.

Tanu rabbanan: hachote gechalim bashshabbat – chayyayv chattat. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok: chayyayv shetayim, mippene shehu mechabbe et haelyonot, umavir et hattachtonot. bemay askinan? i deka mikkavven lechabbot ulehavir – may tama deman defatar? ella dela ka mikkavven lehaveir – may tama deman dimchayyev tarte?

Rabbi elazar verabbi chanina deamri tarvavyyhu: kegon shennitkavven lechabbot haelyonot kede lehaveir et hattachtonot, detanna kamma kasavar: mekalkel behaveara patur, verabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok amar: chayyayv. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: benappach shanu. amar rabbi yochanan: ad kan lo nitgalleta tamah shel halacha zo.
Amme bar avin verav chananya bar avin deamri tarvavyyhu:
b: Kegon shennitkavven lechabbot ulehavir, detanna kamma savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: haveara lelav yatzat,
Verabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok savar la kerabbi natan, deamar: haveara lechallek yatzat.
Rava amar: lehakedim ikka venayyhu.

Rav ashe amar: kegon shennitkavven lechabbot vehuvearu meelehen, vetanna kamma savar la kerabbi shimon, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven – patur, verabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven – chayyayv.

Tanu rabbanan: hachote gechalim beshabbat lehitchammem bahem vehuvearu meelehen – tane chada: chayyayv, vetane iddach: patur. hadtanya: chayyayv, kasavar: melacha sheenah tzericha legufah – chayyayv aleha. veha ditna: patur, kasavar: melacha sheenah tzericha legufah patur aleha.
Hadaran alach safek achal chelev
Mishna achal dam shechita, babbehema bechayya uvaof, ben temein ben tehorin, dam nechira, dam ikkur, dam hakkaza shehanneshama yotza bo – chayyayvin alav.
Dam hattechol, dam hallev, dam betzim, dam chagavim, dam hattamtzit – en chayyayvin alav, rabbi yehuda mechayyev bedam hattamtzit.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "kol dam lo tochlu", shomea ani afillu dam mehalleche shetayim, dam betzim, dam chagavim, dam dagim, hakkol bakkelal? talmud lomar: "leof velivhema",
Ma of uvehema meyuchadin, sheyyesh bahen tumea kalla vetumea chamura, veyesh bahen issur vehetter, vehen min basar – af kol sheyyesh bahen tumea kalla.
Otzi dam mehalleche shetayim – sheyyesh bahen tumea chamura, veen bahen tumea kalla.

a: Otzi dam sheratzim – sheen bahem tumea chamura. otzi dam betzim – sheen min basar, dam dagim dam chagavim – shekkullo hetter.
"Laof velabbehema"? i ma of sheen bah kilayim, af behema – sheen bah kilayim! talmud lomar: "velabbehema".
I ma behema sheenah beem al habbanim, af of sheeno beem al habbanim! talmud lomar: "laof velabbehema".
Veema: "kol dam" – kalal, "of uvehema" – parat, kelal uferat, en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, of uvehema – in, middi acharina – la!
"Nefesh asher tochal kol dam" – chazar vechalal, kelal uferat vechalal, i atta dan ella keen happerat.
Veha la dame kelala batra lichlala kamma, kelala kamma lav, kelala batra karet!
Hay tanna deve rabbi yishmael [beribbuye umiute u]chelale uferate darshinan min haden gavvna, veaf al gav dela dame kelala batra lichlala kamma.

Amar mar: kelal uferat uchelal i atta dan ella cheen happerat, ma happerat meforash – davar sheyyesh bo tumea kalla vetumea chamura, veyesh bahe[50] issur vehetter veyesh bahen min basar, af kol davar sheyyesh bo tumea kalla vetumea chamura vechulei.
"Af kol" dekatane leetoye may?
Amar rav adda bar avin: leetoye damo shel koy. may kasavar? i kasavar koy sefeka hu, itzterich kera lemesar sefeka? ella kasavar koy beriyya bifne atzmo hu.
Ashkechan damo, chelbo menalan? "mikkol chelev". nivlato menalan? "mikkol nevela".
Gid hannashe menalan? bechaf hayyarech talye rachamana, veha it leh kaf hayyarech.
Tumeato ushechita, menalan? sevara, middilchol mille rabbeyeh rachamana kivhema, tumeato ushechitato name kivhema.
Amar mar: otzi dam mehalleche shetayim, sheyyesh bahen tumea chamura veen bahen tumea kalla. ureminhi: hachotech min haadam – tzarich machshava vehechsher.
Vekashya lan: machshava lema li? tease chaticha shello machshava! veamar resh lakish: bechotcho lakkelev, umachshava lakkelev lav machshava hi.
Vela? vehatnan, kelal amru betumea: kol hameyuchad leechol adam – tame, ad sheyyippasel meachilat kelev!

Hahu leassoke tumea minneh, dechevan demeikkara hava chaze leadam, leassoke mittumea ad sheyyippasel meachilat kelev. hacha leachote leh tumea, i chaze leadam – chaze lechelev, i la chaze leadam – la chaze lechelev.
Mikkol makom katane machshava, umachshava – letumea kalla hi! hane mille mechayyim, aval leachar mita – tame hu tumea chamura.
Dichvota gabbe behema leachar mita, i basar – metamme tumea chamura, veim dam – metamme tumea chamura,
Ditnan: dam nevelot – bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein.
Lo nitzrecha ella lichditnan: nivlat behema temea bechol makom, nivlat [ha]of hattahor bakkefarim – tzarich machshava, veen tzarich hechsher.
Nivlat behema tehora bechol makom, venivlat of tahor vechelev bashshevakim – en tzerichin lo machshava velo hechsher.
Vaamar leh rav lerabbi chiyyay: machshava, lema li letumea kalla? hi gufa tumea hi! amar leh: kegon deikka pachot mikkezayit nevela, vetzerfah lefachot mikkevetza ochalin, dehay vehay have kevetza.

I hachi, live name hechsher, deha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "al kol zera [zerua] asher yizzarea" – ma zeraim meyuchadin sheen sofan letamme tumea chamura vetzarich hechsher, af kol sheen sofan letamme tumea chamura tzarich hechsher!
Amar leh: hane mille baochalin dealma, delet behu pachot mikkezayit nevela, aval hacha, deikka begavveh pachot mikkezayit nevela, kevan deillu metzaref leh kezayit – la bae hechsher.
b: Leappoke met, af al gav dimmalle leh – la metamme tumeat ochalin, mishshum devatla dato etzel kol adam.
Rav chananya amar: afillu tema dehave kezayit, hacha vemay askinan? kegon shechippahu bevatzek.
I hachi, hechsher name nive! hane mille baochalin acharine, dela metammu la bemagga vela bemassa. aval hacha, nehi dela metamme bemagga, dekamchappe bevatzek, bemassa mihat litamme, deha taevn leh.
Leappoke met, deaf al gav dechippahu bevatzek metamme tumea chamura, detumea bokaat veola bokaat veyoredet.
Amar mar: yatzu sheratzim sheen bahen tumea. vela? sheretz metamme bemagga! bemassa la metamme.

Amar mar: yatza dam dagim vedam chagavim shekkullo hetter. may kullo hetter? ilema dechelbo muttar – hare chayya dechelbah muttar vedamah asur! veella: mishshum delet behu issur gid hannashe? vahare of delet beh issur gid hannashe, vedamo asur!
Ella may kullo hetter – dela bae shechita.
Amar mar: ma of sheen bo kilayim, af behema – talmud lomar: "behema".
Kilayim demay? illema kilayim deharbaa vechilayim dacharisha, vehatnan: chayya vaof kayyotze bahen!
Ella amar abbaye: shetztzimro en chayyayvin alav mishshum kilayim.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: dam sheratzim lokin alav bichzayit. metivi: dam hattechol, dam hallev, dam hakkelayot, dam evarim – hare ellu belo taase. dam mehalleche shetayim, dam sheratzim uremasim – asur, veen chayyayvin alav!
May en chayyayvin alav – karet, a[val] lav – michayyayv.
Chada, dehayynu resha. veod, tanna millav name ka memaet leh, dekatane: yatza dam sheratzim, sheen bahen tumea chamura!
Amar rabbi zera: hitru bo mishshum sheretz – loke, mishshum dam – eno loke.
Amar rav: dam dagim shekkinneso – asur. metivi: dam dagim, dam chagavim – muttar, vaafillu lechattechilla! hahi beshello kinneso, ki ka amar rav – beshekkinneso.
Dichvota gabbe mehalleche shetayim – beshello kinneso, mi asur? veha tanya: dam sheal gabbe kikkar – gorro veochlo, shel ben hashshinnayim – motztzo uvolo veeno choshesh!
Ella: ki tanya hahi matnita – deit beh kaskassim, ki kaamar rav asur – delet beh kaskassim.

Amar rav sheshet: dam mehalleche shetayim – afillu mitzvat perosh en bo. metivi: dam hattechol, dam hallev, dam hakkelayot, dam evarim – hare ellu belo taase. dam mehalleche shetayim, dam sheratzim uremasim – asur veen chayyayvi[yn] alav! ki tanya asur –

a: Deferash. ki kaamar rav – bidla perash, kidtanya: dam sheal gabbe kikkar – gorro veochlo, shel ben hashshinnayim – motzetz uvolea veeno choshesh.

Ikka dematne la leha derav sheshet al hada, detanya: yachol chalev mehalleche shetayim yehe ochlo over belav? vedin hu: ma behema temea shehekalta bemaggaah, hechmarta bachalavah, mehalleche shetayim shehechmarta bemaggaan – eno din shettachmir bachalavan?
Talmud lomar: "veze lachem hattame" – ze tame, veen chalev mehalleche shetayim tame ella tahor.

Otzi et hechalav, sheen shave bakkol, velo otzi haddam sheshshave bakkol! talmud lomar: "veze lachem hattame" – ze tame, veen dam mehalleche shetayim tame ella tahor. amar (la) rav sheshet: afillu mitzvat perosh en bo.

Tenan hatam: hallev, koro umotzi et damo, lo kerao – eno over alav. amar rabbi zera amar rav: lo shanu ella belev of, hoil veen bo kezayit, aval lev behema deyesh bo kezayit – asur, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Metivi: dam hattechol, dam hallev, dam hakkelayot, dam evarim – hare ellu belo taase. dam mehalleche shetayim, dam shekatzim uremasim – asur, veen chayyayvin alav!
Ki katane "en chayyayvin alav" – al dam dileh, ki kaamar rav – deate leh mealma.
Dam dileh – hayeynu dam evarim! velitamaych, mi la katane dam kelayot vekatane dam evarim? ella: tane vahadar tane – hacha name, tane vahadar tane.
Mealma mehecha ate leh? amar rabbi zera: beshaa shehanneshama yotza misraf saref.
Dam shehanneshama yotza bo – chayyayvin alav. ittemar: ezehu dam hakkaza shehanneshama teluya bo? rabbi yochanan amar: kol zeman shemmekalleach. resh lakish amar: mittippa hammashcheret veelach.

Metivi: ezehu dam hakkaza shehanneshama yotza bo? kol zeman shemmekalleach. yatza dam hattamtzit, mippene shehu shotet. may lav afillu rishon veacharon, deshotet hu – kedam hattamtzit dame? teyuveta deresh lakish!
La, lemaote dam hammashchir, aval dam rishon veacharon, af al gav dehu shotet – hayeynu dam hannefesh.

Metivi: ezehu dam rishon? kol zeman shemmekalleach. yatza rishon veacharon, mippene shehu shotet. teyuveteh deresh lakish! amar lach: tannae hi, detanya: ezehu dam hannefesh? kol zeman shemmekalleach, divre rabbi elazar. rabbi shimon omer: mittippa hammashcheret veelach.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: "vedam chalalim yishte", perat ledam killuach sheeno machshir et hazzeraim.
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: hikkiz dam livhema vekibbel damah bishne chosot, mahu? al harishon – divre hakkol chayyayv, al haacharon – mi michayyayv o la?

Amar leh: pelugeta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish, deittemar: hikkiz dam livhema vekibbel damah bishne chosot – resh lakish amar: chayyayv shete chattaot. verabbi yochanan amar: eno chayyayv ella achat.

Rabbi yehuda mechayyev bedam hattamtzit. amar rabbi elazar: mode rabbi yehuda leinyan kappara, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper" – dam shehannefesh yotza bo mechapper, vesheen hannefesh yotza bo eno mechapper.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena, detanya: "dam", ma talmud lomar "kol dam"?

Lefi shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper", en li ella dam kadashim shehannefesh yotza bo, shehu mechapper, dam chullin vedam hattamtzit, minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol dam". setam sifra manni? rabbi yehuda hi.
Mishna rabbi akiva mechayyev al sefek meila asham taluy, vachachamim potrim. umode rabbi akiva sheeno mevi et meilato ad sheyyitvadda lo sheyyavi immo asham vadday.

Amar rabbi tarfon: ma laze mevi shete ashamot? ella mevi meila vechumeshah, veyavi asham bishne selaim, veyomar: "im vadday maalti – zo meilati vezo ashami, veim safek maalti – hammaot nedava, veasham taluy". shemmimmin shehu mevi al hoda, mevi al lo hoda.

Amar rabbi akiva: nirin devarav bimila meuta. hare sheyyavo leyado sefek meila bemea mane, lo yafe lo sheyyavi asham bishte selaim, velo yavi sefek meila bemea mane? mode rabbi akiva lerabbi tarfon bimila meuta.
b: Gemara tanu rabbanan: "veim nefesh" – lechayyev al sefek meilot asham taluy, divre rabbi akiva, vachachamim potrim.
Lema beha ka mippalgi, derabbi akiva savar: lemedin elyon mittachton, verabbanan savri: en lemedin elyon mittachton?
Amar rav pappa: dechulle alma lemedin elyon mittachton, deim ken, tzafon beven bakar la mashkachat lehu,
Ella hacha hayeynu tama derabbanan defatri: digmiri "mitzvot" "mitzvot" mechattat.
Ma lehallan davar shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, veal sefeko asham taluy, af kol shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal sefeko chattat veal shiggato asham taluy,
Leappoke meila, deen chayyayvin al zedono karet, detanya: hezid bimila – rabbi omer: bemita, vachachamim omrim: beazhara.
Verabbi akiva savar: ki yalfinan "mitzvot" "mitzvot" mechattat chelev, lehachi hu deyalfinan: ma lehallan bikvua, af kan bikvua,
Leappoke ole veyored, dela.
Verabbanan savri: en gezera shava lemechetza. mikkelal derabbi akiva savar: yesh gezera shava lemechetza? ella, dechulle alma en gezera shava lemechetza,
Ella hayeynu tama derabbi akiva, daamar kera: "veim nefesh" – vav mosif al inyan rishon, veyilmad elyon mittachton.
Verabbanan savri: tachton hu degamar meelyon leasham bechesef shekalim.
Verabbi akiva savar: en hekkesh lemechetza. mikkelal derabbanan savri: yesh hekkesh lemechetza? veha kayyma lan deen hekkesh lemechetza!
Dechulle alma en hekkesh lemechetza, vehacha hayeynu tama derabbanan: digmiri "mitzvot" "mitzvot", appekeh mehekkesha.
Verabbi akiva, asham bechesef shekalim nafka leh mizzot torat haasham" – tora achat lechol haashamot, leasham divchesef shekalim.
Verabbanan? af al gav dichtiv "zot torat haasham", itzterich lemichtav "veim nefesh" – vav mosif al inyan rishon, veyilmad tachton meelyon.
Vei mizzot torat haasham", hava amena: ki amena tora achat lechol ashamot – hane mille bishar ashamot vaddain,

Aval asham taluy, kevan deal sefek chelev kaate, ema: la yehe sefeko chamur mivvaddao, ma vaddao – chattat bat danka, af sefeko – asham bar danka, ahachi ketav rachamana: "veim nefesh" – vav mosif al inyan rishon.
Nicha leman dedaresh "zot torat haasham", ella leman dela daresh "zot torat haasham", may ikka lememar? yalef "beerkecha" "beerkecha" measham meilot.
Asham shifcha charufa, la ketiv be "beerkecha"! yalfinan beel"
Mode rabbi akiva kulei veim safek.
May kaamar? amar rava, teni: im bisfeko omed leolam – yehe asham taluy, shemmimmin shehevi al hoda, mevio al shello hoda.
Sof sof, ki mityeda leh bae leetoye asham vadday!
Amar rava: middivre shenehem nilmad – asham vadday la bae yedia lechattechilla.
Mishna haishsha shehevia chattat haof, ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday – taasenna vadday, shemmimmin shehi mevia al hoda, mevia al lo hoda.
Chaticha shel chullin vachaticha shel hekdesh, achal achat mehen veen yodea eze mehen achal – patur, rabbi akiva mechayyev asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya – mevi asham vadday.
Achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya – ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer: shenehen meviin asham echad. rabbi yose omer:

a: En shenayim meviin asham echad.

Chatichat chelev vachatichat chullin, achal achat mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal – mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya – mevi chattat. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya – ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer: shenehem meviin chattat achat. rabbi yose omer: en shenayim meviin chattat achat.

Chatichat chelev vachatichat kodesh, achal achat mehen veeno yodea eze mehen achal – mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya – mevi chattat veasham vadday. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya – ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy. rabbi shimon omer: shenehen meviin chattat veasham. rabbi yose omer: en shenayim meviin chattat veasham echad.
Chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev kodesh, achal achat mehen veen yodea ezo mehen achal – mevi chattat, rabbi akiva omer: af asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya – mevi shene chattaot veasham vadday.

Achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya – ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat. rabbi akiva omer: ze vaze meviin asham taluy. rabbi shimon omer: ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat, ushenehen meviin asham echad. rabbi yose omer: en shenehen meviin asham echad.
Chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev notar, achal achat mehen veen yodea eze mehen achal – mevi chattat veasham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya – mevi shalosh chattaot.

Achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya – ze mevi chattat veasham taluy, veze mevi chattat veasham taluy. rabbi shimon omer: ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat, ushenehen meviin chattat achat. rabbi yose omer: kol chattat shehi baa al chet – en shenayim meviin otah.
Gemara amar leh rava lerav nachman: lerabbi yose, chattat hu dela mayytu shenehen, ha asham taluy mayytu shenehem? hayeynu tanna kamma!
Vechi tema: chaticha mishte chatichot ikka benayyhu, vehatanya: rabbi yose omer: ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy! amar leh: ha ka mashma lan, deman tanna kamma – rabbi yose.

Chatichat chelev vachatichat kodesh, chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev kodesh kulei chatichat chelev vachatichat chelev notar kulei. amar leh rava lerav nachman: velayte name asham vadday, denotar dekodesh hu! amar leh: delet beh shave peruta.
Veha meikkara deit beh shave peruta askinan, dekatane asham vadday! amar leh: hahi chaticha dela notar hi shavya peruta.
Veha yesh ochel achila achat dekatane beh notar, vekatane: mevi arba chattaot veasham echad!
Amar leh: hahi – begassa, vehahi – bedakka, vela kashya: hahi – bimot haggeshamim, hacha – bimot hachamma.
Achal echad et harishona kulei. amar leh rava lerav nachman: umi amar rabbi shimon issur chal issur?
Veha tanya, rabbi shimon omer: haochel nevela beyom hakkippurim – patur!
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: kegon daachal kuleya bechelbah. vechuleya bechelbah name, ha kae ala beissur olin, hechi ate issur notar chayel ala?

Vechi tema: sevira leh lerabbi shimon denotar issur chamur hu, vechayel al issur kal deolin, veha nevela, deissur kal hu, veyom hakkippurim, deissur chamur hu, vela kaate issur yom kippurim dechamur vechayel al nevela dekal hu!
Ella: bekadashim galli rachamana deate issur chal al issur,
b: Detanya: "asher laAdonai" – lerabbot et haemurin.
Veemurin kae alayyhu beissur olin, vechelev kae aleyhv beissur karet, vekaate issur tumea chayel aleh.

Teda shekken hu, deha rabbi sevira leh issur chal al issur, (veema) vehane mille issur chamur al issur kal, aval issur kal chal al issur vehu issur chamur – la. uvekodashim shaminan leh deamar: issur kal al issur chamur name chayel,
Deha issur meila kal hu – mita, veissur kadashim issur chamur – karet, veate issur mita chayel al issur karet.
Detanya: rabbi omer: "kol chelev laAdonai" – lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila.
Umeila issur mita, veka chayel al issur chelev, deissur karet hu, shema minna: bekadashim galli kera.
Veha tanya, rabbi shimon omer: en piggul baolin veen notar baolin!
Ella tannae hi, veallibba derabbi shimon, deikka deamri: bekadashim issur chal al issur, veikka deamri: bekadashim name en issur chal al issur.
Uleman deamar: bekadashim name en issur chal al issur, "kol chelev laAdonai" may aved leh?
Mokem leh bevalde kadashim, dekasavri: valde kadashim – bahavayaytan yehu kedoshim, detarvayyhu bahadade atu.
Hadaran alach dam shechita
Mishna hammevi asham taluy, venoda lo shello chata, im ad shello nishchat – yetze veyire baeder, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer: yikrav, sheim eno ba al chet ze – hare hu ba al chet acher.
Im mishshennishchat noda lo – yishshafech haddam, vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa. nizrak haddam vehabbasar kayyaym – yeachel. rabbi yose omer: afillu haddam bakkos – yizzarek, vehabbasar yeachel.
Asham vadday eno ken, ad shello nishchat – yetze veyire baeder. mishshennishchat – hare ze yikkaver. nizrak haddam – habbasar yetze levet hasserefa.
Shor hanniskal eno ken, ad shello niskal – yetze veyire baeder. mishshenniskal – muttar bahanaa.
Egla arufa eno ken, ad shello neerfa – tetze vetire baeder, mishshenneerfa – tikkaver bimkomah, sheal safek baa mittechilla, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah.
Gemara bemay peligi? rabbi meir savar: kevan dela tzerich leh, la makdesh leh. verabbanan savri: mittoch shellibbo nokfo, gomer umakdish.

Tana: ben shennoda lo shechata uven noda lo shello chata peligi rabbi meir verabbanan. benoda lo shechata – lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir, deaf al gav deyada dachata, kevan dividdana deafresheh [la yeda – tetze vetire baeder.
Uvenoda lo shello chata – lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, deaf al gav dela chata, kevan dividdana deafresheh la yeda] – libbo nokfo hava, hilkach gamar umakdesh.
Amar rav sheshet: mode rabbi meir lachachamim

a: Bemafrish shene ashamot leachrayut venitkapper beachat mehen, desheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava.

May tama? ad kan la peligi rabbi meir alehon derabbanan ella mishshum dela galli dateh delibbo nokfo, aval hacha, mikkedi chad hu deibbei leh leafroshe, may tama afresh tere? desavar: i mirchas chada mikkapparna beiddach chavreh, vechevan degalli dateh delibbo nokfo haya, hoil vechach haya gamar vehikdisho.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: modim chachamim lerabbi meir beasham taluy shehuzzammu edav, deyetze veyire baeder.

May tama? ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh ella hecha deafresheh al pi atzmo, veamrinan libbo nokfo, aval hecha deal pi edim afresheh – la hava samech illave edim, desavar: dilma atu acherim umazzemi lehu.

Metiv rava: shor hanniskal eno ken, im ad shello niskal – yetze veyire baeder. hechi dame? illema deatu be tere amri "harag", uve tere amri "lo harag" – may chazet detzayyta[t] levatrae? tziyt lehu lekammae!
Ella lav beede hazama. vedichvoteh gabbe asham taluy – beede hazama, ufeligi!
Amar leh abbaye: vedilma shor hanniskal hechi dame – kegon shebba harug beraglav.
Vedichvoteh gabbe asham taluy – kegon dehukkera chaticha. aval hecha deafresheh leasham taluy al pi edim – la.
Biflugeta: asham taluy shehuzzammu edav – rabbi elazar omer: hare hi keminchat kenaot, detanya: nimtzeu edeha zommin – minchatah tetze lechullin.

Rabbi yochanan amar: yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava. verabbi yochanan, nedammeyeh leminchat kenaot! la dame, minchat kenaot la lechappara kaatyay, ella levarer avon. aval asham taluy, dilchappara ate, mittoch shellibbo nokfo gomer umakdisho.
Amar rabbi kerusepaday amar rabbi yochanan: shor hanniskal shehuzzammu edav – kol hammachazik bo zacha bo.
Amar rava: mistabbera tama derabbi yochanan, kegon deamri leh: nirba shoro. aval amru: rava shoro, hu beatzmo midda yaday dela reva vela mafkar leh, vetarach umayyte edim.
Umay shena meha deamar rabba bar ittay amar resh lakish: ir hanniddachat shehuzzammu edeha – kol hammachazik bah zacha bah?

Ir hanniddachat, derabbim ninhu, kol chad amar bedateh: ana la chatay, acharina chata, umafkar mamoneh. aval hacha, divdideh talya milleta, hu beatzmo midda yada dela reva, vela mafkar leh, vetarach umayyte edim.
Amar resh lakish: hannoten mattana lachavero, veamar halla: "i efshi bah" – kol hammachazik bah zacha bah.

Umay shena meha deamar rabba bar avu amar rav sheshet, veamri la amar rabbi avahu amar rav sheshet: mekabbel mattana sheamar leachar shebbat mattana leyado: "mattana zo tibbatel", "mevuttelet", "i efshi bah" – devarav kayyaymin. "betela", "enah mattana" – lo amar kelum.
b: May lav "devarav kayyaymin" – dehadra lemara? la, devarav kayyaymin – vehu name la kane la, vechol hammachazik bah zacha bah.
Metivi: haomer lachavero: "din udevarim en li al sade zo", "en li esek bah", veyadi mesulleket hemenna" – lo amar kelum. veha "yadi mesulleket hemenna" kei efshi dame, vekatane: lo amar kelum!
Shane hatam, deamar: ki sallek nafsheh middin udevarim, miggufa desade la sallek nafsheh.

Metivi: hakkotev nechasav laacherim vehayu bahen avadim, veamar halla: "i efshi bahen", im haya rabbo sheni kohen – ochlin bitruma. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kevan sheamar: "i efshi bahen" – kevar zachu bahen yorshin.
Bishlama lerabban shimon ben gamliel, kasavar: ki yahev inish mattana addata dimkabbelin la minneh, ki la mekabbelin la minneh hadra lemara.

Ella letanna kamma, i ki amar "i efshi bahen" – kol hammachazik bahen zacha bahen, hacha, deamar sheni "i efshi bahen" – havu lehu zarim, vekaachli zarim teruma! kasavar: hammafkir avdo – yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo, vekasavar: meukkav leget shichrur – ochel bitruma.
Rabbi eliezer omer: yikrav kulei. lerabbi eliezer, lema li chet? ha amar rabbi eliezer: asham taluy bindava ate, ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom!
Amar rav ashe: rabbi eliezer deamru lo hu, ditnan: ella omrim lo: hameten ad shettikkanes levet hassafek.
Im mishshennishchat noda kulei. katane: habbasar yetze levet hasserefa. alma: chullin shennishchatu baazara – bisrefa.
Ureminhi: asham vadday eno ken, im ad shello nishchat – yetze veyire baeder, mishshennishchat – hare ze yikkaver! amar rabbi elazar: tivra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.
Amar rabba: asham vadday al asham taluy karamet? asham vadday, kevan dela tzerich leh – la makdesh leh. asham taluy, mittoch shellibbo nokfo – gomer umakdisho.
Ella i kashya, asham vadday al asham vadday kashya, dekatane: hare ze yikkaver, ema sefa: vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa! ha vadday tivra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.
Rav ashe amar: resha dekatane beasham taluy: "vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa" – la kashya, mishshum demitchaze kezevach pasul.
Nizrak haddam – habbasar yeachel. veammay? ha haveya leh yedia! amar rava, amar kera: "vehu lo yada venislach lo", veha la havya leh yedia bishat selicha.

Rabbi yose omer: afillu haddam bakkos kulei. lerabbi yose, ammay yizzarek? ha havya leh yedia bishat selicha! amar rava: rabbi yose savar la kerabbi shimon, deamar: kol haomed lizzarek – kezaruk dame.
Emar deamar rabbi shimon, bemidde deomed lizzarek, aval hay, en omed lizzarek! amri bemareva, kasavar rabbi yose: kele sharet mekaddeshin bo et happasul battechilla likrav.
Asham vadday eno ken kulei. ittemar: egla arufa ematay neeseret? rav hamenuna amar: mechayyim, rava amar: leachar arifa.
Bishlama lerava – meiddana deitavid ba maase, ella lerav hamenuna, meematay?

a: Amar rabbi yannay: gevul shamati bah veshachachti, venasvin chavrayyay lememar: yeridatah lenachal etan osartah.
Amar rav hamenuna: mena amena la? ditnan: hashshochet parat chattat, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa – rabbi shimon poter, vachachamim mechayyeyvin.
Bishlama ledidi, deamena mechayyim, beha peligi rabbi shimon verabbanan, derabbi shimon savar: shechita sheenah reuya – lo shemah shechita.
Verabbanan amri: shechita sheenah reuya – shemah shechita. ella i amrat leachar arifa, ammay patar rabbi shimon? shechita reuya hi!

Vechi tema: savar rabbi shimon egla bishchita keshera, vehatnan: kasher bappara pasul – beegla arufa, pasul bappara – kasher beegla arufa. para, bishchita – keshera, baarifa – pesula, egla, baarifa – keshera, bishchita – pesula!
Ishtik. levatar dinfak, amar: may tama la amena leh derabbi shimon savar: egla bishchita keshera!
Verav hamenuna amar lach: la nishtemit tanna denashmeinan egla bishchita keshera, detema rabbi shimon hi.
Amar rava: mena amena la? midditnan: egla arufa enah ken, ad shello neerfa – tetze vetire baeder. vei amrat mechayyim, ammay tetze vetire baeder? ha ittasra la mechayyim!
Teni: ad shello niret laarifa. ema sefa: mishshenneerfa – tikkaver bimkomah! teni: mishshenniret laarifa.
Im ken, ema sefa: sheal hassafek baa mittechilla, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah. vei mechayyim, adayin lo kippera sefekah!
Tannae hi, detanya: neemar machshir umechapper bifnim, veneemar machshir umechapper bachutz.
Ma machshir umechapper haamur bifnim, asa bo machshir kimchapper – af machshir [umechapper] haamur bachutz, asa machshir kimchapper.

Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom uvechol et sheyyirtze. hu haya nikra asham chasidim. amru alav al bava ben buta shehaya mitnaddev asham taluy bechol yom, chutz meachar yom kippurim yom echad.
Amar: hammaon hazze! illu hayu mannichin li hayiti mevi, ella omrim li: hameten ad shettikkanes lesafek. vachachamim omrim: en mevi asham taluy ella al shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat.

Chayyayve chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim – chayyayvin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim, vechayyayve ashamot teluyin – peturin. mi shebba beyado sefek avera beyom hakkippurim, afillu im chashecha – patur, shekkol hayyom mechapper.

Haishsha sheyyesh aleha chattat haof safek, veavar aleha yom hakkippurim – chayyevet lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim, mippene shehi machsheret leechol bizvachim. chattat haof habbaa al hassafek, im mishshennimleka noda – tikkaver.
Gemara may tama derabbi eliezer? i salka datach chova hi, [ki] mityeyda leh, ammay mayyte chattat? ella shema minna: nedava hi.

Verabbanan: ola ushelamim hu deatu beneder unedava, aval chattat veasham – chova ninhu. veasham taluy, hayeynu tama demayyte mikkamme demityeyda leh – lehagen alav, dehattora chasa al gufan shel yisrael.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: dilma asham taluy keola ushelamim, ma ola ushelamim deatu bechova veatu bindava, asham taluy name, deate bechova, ate name bindava!
Amar leh: ola ushelamim ikkar bindava ketivi, asham taluy ikkar bechova ketiv.
Tane rabbi chiyyay kammeh derava:
b: Asham taluy ba al hannevela. amar leh: vehaanan tenan, vachachamim omrim: eno mevi asham taluy ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat! vei rabbi eliezer, bindava name ate!
Amar leh: may tama la matnet? zimnin saggiin teneta kamme mar, umannu – rabba, veamar li: ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi deamru lo, ditnan: ella omrim lo hameten ad shettikkanes levet hassafek.
Amar rava: may tama deamru lo? amar kera: "asher lo teasena (bishgaga) veashem".
Amar rava: may tama derabbanan, deamri: en meviin asham taluy ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat? "mitzvot" "mitzvot", mechattat chelev,
Ma lehallan, shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat, af kan, davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat.

Tanu rabbanan: chamishsha ashamot mechapperin, asham taluy en mechapper kappara gemura. may kaamar? amar rav yosef, hachi kaamar: chamishsha ashamot mechapperin kappara gemura, veasham taluy en mechapper kappara gemura.
Udela kerabbi eliezer, deamar: asham taluy ba al hannevela.

Ravina amar: hachi katane: chamishsha ashamot – en acher mechapper kapparatan, dechi mityeyda leh mayyte. asham taluy – acher mechapper kapparato, dilchi mityeyda [leh] la mayyte, keditnan: chayyayve chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim – chayyayvin lehavi achar yom hakkippurim. chayyayve ashamot teluyin – peturin.

Chayyayve chattaot vaashamot vaddain kulei. katane: chayyayve chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim – chayyayvin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim, chayyayve ashamot teluyin – peturin. menahane mille?

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi amme amar rabbi chanina: amar kera: "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumeot bene yisrael umippishehem lechol chattotam", chataim dumeya difshaim, ma peshaim delav bene korban – af chataim delav bene korban – mechapper, aval chataim bene korban – la mechappar.

Amar leh abbaye: veha ki ketiv haden kara besair hannaase bifnim hu dichtiv, dela mechappar al averot demitzva yedua, aval sair hammishtalleach, dimchappar al averot demitzva yedua, ema lach: afillu al chataim divne korban ninhu mechappar!

Ella amar abbaye, mehacha: "vehitvadda alav [et] kol avonot bene yisrael veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam", chataim dumeya difshaim, ma peshaim delav bene korban – af chataim delav bene korban, aval chataim divne korban ninhu – la mechappar. umayateh kera besair hammishtalleach, lememra deal chataim divne korban ninhu la mechappar.
Amar leh rav dimi: mimmay dehane peshaim lav bene korban ninhu? dilma hane divne korban ninhu, keditnan: arbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga.

Ittemar name: ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yose amar resh lakish: "vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam", chataim dumeya difshaim, ma peshaim delav bene korban mechapper, af chataim delav bene korban mechapper, aval chataim divne korban – la mechappar.

Amar abbaye: ana name mehaden kera amri, veakshi li rav dimi: mimmay dehane peshaim delav bene korban ninhu? dilma hanach divne korban ninhu, keditnan: arbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga! amar leh ravin: rov peshaim lav bene korban. amar leh: mide rov ketiv?
Ella amar abbaye: meresheh dikra: "vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael", vetanya: "avonot" – ellu zedonot. vechen hu omer: "avonah bah".
"Veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam" – "kol" lema li? leakshoye lifshaim, ma peshaim delav bene korban, af chataim delav bene korban, aval chataim divne korban ninhu – la mechappar.
Chayyayve ashamot teluyin kulei. menahane mille? amar rabbi elazar, amar kera: "mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai vegomer" – chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom – yom hakkippurim mechapper.
Amar rav tachlifa avu derav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava: kadmayyta name la tete
